plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-locale-ko

**한국어** | [English](README.en.md)

**DeepSeek Harness(DSH) 비공식 한국어 언어팩** · 딥시크 하네스 한글 패치

> **Korean (한국어) UI language pack for [DeepSeek Harness](https://www.deepseek.com/en/harness/).**
> Install it from **Plugins → Add plugin** with `https://github.com/jjoni12/dsh-locale-ko`, then pick 한국어 in Settings → General → Language.
> Unofficial community translation; not affiliated with or endorsed by DeepSeek.

DeepSeek Harness의 화면(채팅, 사이드바, 설정, 플러그인, 자동화 작업, 파일 미리보기, 대화상자 등)을 한국어로 바꿔 주는 플러그인입니다.
앱 프로그램 파일은 건드리지 않고 DSH 플러그인으로만 설치되기 때문에, 플러그인 화면에서 언제든 끄거나 제거할 수 있습니다.

| 적용 전 | 적용 후 |
|---|---|
| ![적용 전: 영어 화면](docs/before-main.png) | ![적용 후: 한국어 화면](docs/after-main.png) |

<details>
<summary>스크린샷 더 보기 (설정, 플러그인 화면)</summary>

![설정 → 일반 화면](docs/settings.png)

![플러그인 화면의 한국어 언어팩 상세 정보](docs/plugins.png)

</details>

## 기준 앱

이 언어팩은 DeepSeek의 [DeepSeek Harness 공식 페이지](https://www.deepseek.com/en/harness/)에서 배포하는 **공식 데스크톱 앱**(Download for Windows)을 기준으로 만들었습니다. 같은 페이지에서 안내하는 `npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web`(Web UI)에서도 동작합니다.

이 프로젝트는 비공식 커뮤니티 번역이며, DeepSeek가 만들거나 보증한 것이 아닙니다.

## 지원 버전

| 앱 | 버전 |
|---|---|
| [DeepSeek Harness 공식 데스크톱 앱](https://www.deepseek.com/en/harness/) (Windows 64-bit) | 0.2.1-rc.2 |
| `npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web` (Web UI) | 0.2.1-rc.2 |

다른 버전에서는 일부 문구가 영어로 나오거나 동작하지 않을 수 있습니다.

## 설치

Node.js나 터미널은 필요 없습니다.

1. DeepSeek Harness 왼쪽 사이드바에서 **플러그인**을 엽니다.
2. 오른쪽 위 **플러그인 추가**를 누르고, 아래 주소를 입력한 뒤 **설치**를 누릅니다.

   ```
   https://github.com/jjoni12/dsh-locale-ko
   ```

3. 설치가 끝나면 **지금 켜기**를 누릅니다. 다시 시작하지 않아도 바로 적용됩니다.

설정 → 일반 → 언어에서 `한국어`를 고를 수 있습니다. 운영체제 언어가 한국어이고 따로 고른 언어가 없으면 자동으로 한국어가 선택됩니다.

### 끄기 / 제거 / 업데이트

- **끄기**: 플러그인 → 설치된 플러그인 → 한국어 언어팩의 스위치를 끕니다.
- **제거**: 한국어 언어팩을 눌러 상세 화면에서 **제거**를 누릅니다.
- **업데이트**: 제거한 뒤 같은 주소로 다시 설치합니다.

설치, 끄기, 제거는 모두 DSH 앱의 **플러그인 화면**에서 처리되며, 언어팩은 **내 설정 파일**(`cordis.patch.yml`)을 직접 수정하지 않습니다.

## 구성

| 파일 | 역할 |
|---|---|
| `package.json` | DSH 플러그인 선언 (번들 + 클라이언트 플러그인) |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | 번들을 켜면 언어팩 플러그인을 불러오는 설정 |
| `lib/client.js` | 빌드된 언어팩 본체 |
| `locale/*.json` | 플러그인 화면에 표시되는 이름과 설명 (영어·중국어·한국어) |
| `icon.svg` | 플러그인 아이콘 |
| `src/ko-dict.json` | 앱 번역 시스템에 등록된 문구의 한국어 번역 (0.2.1 기준 56개 네임스페이스, 2,566개 키) |
| `src/ko-static.json` | 번역 시스템을 거치지 않는 문구의 한국어 번역. `global`(어디서나), `plugins`(플러그인 화면 안에서만) 두 묶음 |
| `src/client.template.js`, `src/build.mjs` | 위 파일들로 `lib/client.js`를 만드는 템플릿과 빌드 스크립트 |

## 번역 수정하기

`src/ko-dict.json` 또는 `src/ko-static.json`을 고친 뒤 빌드하세요.

```bash
node src/build.mjs
```

오역이나 빠진 문구는 Issue나 Pull Request로 알려 주세요.

## 동작 방식

- DSH가 제공하는 언어팩 API로 `ko` 언어(대체 언어 `en`)를 추가하고, 네임스페이스별 한국어 사전을 등록합니다. 언어 선택은 DSH가 직접 설정에 저장합니다.
- 번역 시스템을 거치지 않는 일부 문구는, 화면에 표시된 텍스트가 정확히 일치할 때만 한국어로 바꿉니다. 다른 언어로 바꾸면 즉시 원래 문구로 돌아갑니다.
  - 플러그인 이름·설명은 플러그인 화면 안에서만 바꿉니다.
  - "Status", "Tools" 같은 짧은 단어는 바꾸지 않습니다. 같은 이름의 파일·폴더·세션 제목이 잘못 바뀌지 않도록 하기 위해서입니다.
  - 대화 본문(AI 답변, 사용자 메시지, 추론 내용, 코드)은 바꾸지 않습니다.

## 한계

- 앱 자체에 내장된 화면은 번역할 수 없습니다. 공식 데스크톱 앱의 창 메뉴(Application, Edit 등)가 여기에 해당합니다.
- 설정 → 기본 제공 플러그인 목록의 패키지 설명은 각 패키지의 개발자용 설명이라 공식 중국어판에서도 영어로 나오며, 이 언어팩도 번역하지 않습니다.
- 외부 플러그인과 서버에서 내려오는 일부 문구(도구 이름, 오류 원문 등)는 영어로 남을 수 있습니다.
- 앱이 업데이트되면 새 문구가 영어로 나올 수 있습니다.

## 라이선스

[MIT](LICENSE)

번역의 원문은 MIT 라이선스로 배포되는 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)(Copyright (c) 2026 DeepSeek)의 UI 문구입니다. 자세한 내용은 [NOTICE](NOTICE)를 보세요.

# dsh-skill-install

A [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) skill installer. From the Web settings page
(Settings → "Skills"), search GitHub repositories by name or paste a repo URL, list the `SKILL.md` skills inside,
tick the ones you want, and install them to a target directory. Integrates with the built-in skill-filesystem, so
installed skills take effect immediately — no restart required.

[中文](README.zh.md)

## Features

- **Search by name / paste a URL**: one input accepts a skill/repo name (searches repos by name), or `owner/repo`
  and `https://github.com/owner/repo` addresses.
- **Only matched repos**: search returns concrete matching repositories; click "Open" to browse their skills.
  There is no full-site discovery feed.
- **Selectable target, global by default**:
  - Global → `<dshHome>/skills` (watched by skill-filesystem by default)
  - Current project → `<project root>/.dsh/skills` (project root = nearest `.git` ancestor, else cwd)
  - Custom directory → any absolute directory; the plugin registers its own skill provider and hot-refreshes it
- **Installed list**: grouped by target directory, one-click removal.
- **Currently loaded skills**: the merged set from the built-in skill-filesystem and this plugin (read-only).
- **Proxy (collapsed entry)**: configure a proxy address, test connectivity, or clear it; requests go through the
  system `curl` when set, direct otherwise.

## Install

```sh
# Local directory — quit the Desktop app first; --profile is required.
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add ./dsh-skill-install

# From GitHub
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add github:<owner>/dsh-skill-install
```

Then restart Harness so the new bundle composes; "Settings → Skills" shows the new page. This package has
**zero external runtime dependencies** (`js-yaml` is bundled as a self-contained ESM build), so a GitHub install
needs no `allowBuilds` code-execution approval.

## Runtime dependencies

- The host plugin is pure ESM with no external runtime dependencies (`js-yaml` is bundled in `js-yaml.mjs`, MIT).
- Extracting the GitHub tarball needs system `tar` (built into Windows 10 1809+); using a proxy needs `curl`.

## Skill-system integration

- Global / project installs write into the standard roots watched by skill-filesystem, so the watcher hot-loads them;
- Custom directories are registered as an independent skill provider via `ctx.skills.registerProvider`, using the
  same discovery rules (`<root>/<name>/SKILL.md` or `<root>/<name>.md`), invalidated on install / remove / changes;
- All routes and providers are registered with `ctx.effect`, so they are removed automatically on disable / reload.

## License

MIT

plugins.description: Strata model server monitor panel for DeepSeek Harness: monitor page, floating window, composer status line.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-strata-monitor

在 DeepSeek Harness 里嵌入 Strata 模型服务器的状态监控面板。
A model-server monitor panel for DeepSeek Harness, mirroring the Strata server's Monitor tab.

## 功能 / Features

- **监控页 / Monitor page**：侧边栏新增图标，展示模型状态（空闲 / 读取提示词 / 生成中 / 排队）、解码与预填充速度、GPU 负载、显存、温度、功耗、PCIe、CPU、磁盘读取（均带历史曲线）、会话缓存（KV cache 驻留/复用统计）、最近请求表与累计统计。
- **悬浮小窗 / Floating window**：悬浮于所有页面之上的迷你状态窗，可拖动、右下角缩放，可在设置中开关。
- **输入框状态条 / Composer status line**：对话输入框下方的单行迷你状态，可在设置中开关。
- **会话门控 / Session gate**：小窗与状态条只在当前对话使用的模型与 Strata 报告的模型一致时出现；切换到其他模型时自动隐藏。监控页始终可用。
- **面板内配置 / In-panel settings**：服务器地址与 API key 都可在面板右上角「设置」里修改，保存后立即生效，无需重启。

## 前置条件 / Requirements

- DeepSeek Harness（桌面版或 Web 版均可）。
- 一个正在运行的 Strata 服务器（提供 `GET /health` 与 `GET /metrics`，后者需要 Bearer API key）。

## 安装 / Install

### 方式一：插件市场（推荐）/ Via the plugin market (recommended)

在 Harness 的插件市场里添加自定义目录来源（catalog source），manifest URL 填：

```
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Paidaxing-Tiancai/dsh-strata-monitor/main/catalog-source.json
```

添加后在市场中搜索 `dsh-strata-monitor`，点击安装即可。

Add this custom catalog source in the Harness plugin market, then search for `dsh-strata-monitor` and install:

```
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Paidaxing-Tiancai/dsh-strata-monitor/main/catalog-source.json
```

### 方式二：手动 / Manually

在 Harness 的插件管理中安装本 bundle（clone 本仓库后选择该目录），或在对话里让代理执行：

```
plugin_manager install_bundle → 本仓库 clone 后的绝对路径
```

安装后刷新页面（Ctrl+R），侧边栏会出现「模型监控」图标。

## 配置 / Configuration

推荐直接在监控页右上角「设置」中填写：

- **服务器地址**：例如 `http://192.168.10.117:8080`（保存后立即生效）。
- **API key**：Strata 的访问密钥。

也可以写在 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 里（`strata-monitor` 行的 `config.baseUrl` / `config.apiKey`）。面板内保存的值写入
`~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/strata-monitor.json`，优先级高于 yml 配置。

### 服务器地址与密钥在哪里 / Where to find the server URL and key

Strata 的地址与密钥写在它自己的启动配置文件里，通用路径为 `~/Strata/<配置名>.json`
（例如 `/home/<用户名>/Strata/strata-iq3_s.json`）。文件里能看到监听地址/端口与 API key；
Strata 的网页本身不显示密钥，请从该文件复制。

The Strata server keeps its bind address and API key in its own launch config file, typically at
`~/Strata/<profile>.json` (e.g. `/home/<user>/Strata/strata-iq3_s.json`). The Strata web UI never
shows the key — copy it from that file.

## 安全 / Security

- API key 只保存在 Host 端本机的状态文件里，**永远不会回传到浏览器**。
- 浏览器只访问 Harness 自身的同源代理路由 `/strata-monitor/health|metrics`，由 Host 侧转发到 Strata，因此没有 CORS 问题，key 也不经过前端。

## 故障排查 / Troubleshooting

- 显示「未配置」/提示需要 API key：在「设置」里填入 key。
- 显示「无法连接 Strata 服务器」：检查服务器地址、Strata 是否在运行、防火墙。
- 更新插件后界面没变化：按 Ctrl+R 刷新页面（客户端模块在页面启动时加载）。

## 许可 / License

MIT，见 [LICENSE](./LICENSE)。

plugins.description: DSH right-sidebar file helper: annotate a selection in the document preview (text lines / Excel ranges / Word-PDF pages) or right-click a file, then send the quote plus your note into the current chat. Also ships the standalone zh/en/ja README summary.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-file-to-chat

**把右侧栏里的内容，带着你的批注，直接送进当前对话。**

在 DeepSeek Harness Web 的右侧栏里划选一段文字、框选一块 Excel 区域，或者在文件树上右键一个文件 —— 选区（或整份文件）连同你写的批注一起进入输入框，发出去之后自动收成一枚小胶囊，聊天记录不再被大段引用撑爆。

> Annotate a selection or a whole file in the DSH right-sidebar and send it into the current chat with your note. The quote reaches the model in full; the transcript only shows a small capsule.

```
输入框：  [📄 引用 · 套餐对比.xlsx · 结论速览 B8]  这条再确认下

发出去：  > 📄 引用来源：<绝对路径>（工作表 结论速览 · 区域 B8）
          > 速率上限：官方账户级并发 2,500，可免费扩容
          
          批注： 这条再确认下

聊天里：  [📄 套餐对比.xlsx · 结论速览 B8]   ← 点一下可以展开全文
```

---

## 功能

### 1. 文档预览里划词批注

支持右侧栏文档预览的**全部三种渲染器**：

| 预览类型 | 怎么选 | 引用块里定位到 |
|---|---|---|
| 文本 / 代码 / Markdown | 直接划选文字 | `（第 N 行）` 或 `（第 N-M 行）` |
| Excel / CSV / TSV | 在表格里拖选区域 | `（工作表 <名> · 区域 B3:D7）`，并把区域内的值取成 Markdown 表格 |
| Word / PPT / PDF | 在文字层里划选 | `（第 N 页）` 或 `（第 N-M 页）` |

选区上方会浮出一枚「批注」按钮（选区太靠页面顶部时自动落到下方），点开写批注，`Enter` 发送，`Shift+Enter` 换行，`Esc` 取消。**拖选过程中不会弹**，松手才出现。

### 2. 文件树右键菜单

在右侧栏「文件」标签页的文件或文件夹上右键：

| 菜单项 | 作用 |
|---|---|
| 发送到聊天 | 读正文并开卡片（文本直接内联，`.docx` / `.xlsx` 在浏览器里解包抽正文，其余按字节回退） |
| 只发送路径 | 不读正文，只发路径与「未读取正文」说明 —— 大文件/二进制文件的安全选项 |
| 发送目录清单 | 文件夹专用，列出目录内容 |
| **用默认程序打开** | 交给系统关联程序（等同双击），文件夹则交给文件管理器 |
| 复制完整路径 / 复制相对路径 | 复制到剪贴板 |

### 3. 已发送引用块的折叠

发出去的消息里那段 `> 📄 引用来源：…` 会自动折成一枚胶囊：**模型收到的一字不减，聊天窗口只显示标题**。点胶囊展开，移开鼠标自动合上。

---

## 安装

需要 **DSH Web 0.2.x**（开发与验证均在 `0.2.0-rc.2` 与 `0.2.1-rc.2` 上完成，两个版本均实测可用）。

### 方式一：从 Git 仓库装（推荐）

桌面端（DeepSeek Harness 应用）的 profile 是 `desktop`：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add https://gitee.com/mofeo/dsh-file-to-chat.git
```

`dsh web` 起的 Web 端把 profile 换成 `web`：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add https://gitee.com/mofeo/dsh-file-to-chat.git
```

装完在 **设置 → 插件** 里确认它是启用状态，然后**硬刷新一次浏览器**（`Ctrl+Shift+R`）。

### 方式二：手动放进 profile

```bash
git clone https://gitee.com/mofeo/dsh-file-to-chat.git
# 把目录链接/复制到：~/.dsh/profiles/desktop/node_modules/dsh-file-to-chat
```

再把 `dsh-file-to-chat` 追加到 `~/.dsh/profiles/desktop/package.json` 的 `dsh.profile.bundles` 数组里，重启应用。Web 端把路径里的 `desktop` 换成 `web`。

### 卸载

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop remove dsh-file-to-chat
```

Web 端把 `desktop` 换成 `web`。

> **注意**：有会话正在跑的时候卸载会被拒绝（`refused while agents are running`），先停掉再卸。

---

## 用法

1. 在右侧栏打开「文件」标签页，点开任意文件进入预览。
2. 划选（文本/Word/PDF）或在表格里拖选区域（Excel）。
3. 选区上方出现「📝 批注」→ 点开 → 写批注（可留空）。
4. `Enter` 或点「发送到聊天」。
5. 输入框里出现一枚胶囊，**按你自己的节奏按发送键** —— 插件只负责填草稿，不替你发送。

---

## 已知限制

- **只有右侧栏能触发。** 右侧栏未激活的标签页内容不挂载，所以预览没打开时工具栏上不会有入口（文件树那个座位上只挂一个不渲染任何东西的桥接组件）。
- **Word/PPT/PDF 没有行号**，只能定位到页码 —— 这类文件走的是「Office → PDF → PDF.js」渲染链，页内没有源码行这个概念。
- **Excel 只取当前工作表**，且内联上限 200 行；`.xlsx` 公式取缓存值而非重算。
- **读不到正文的文件不会假装成功**：`.docx`/`.xlsx` 靠浏览器解包抽取，抽不出来时卡片会明说原因，只发引用来源行，让模型自己去读文件。
- **依赖若干 DSH 内部 DOM 约定**（见下节）。DSH 升级后如果这些锚点变了，插件内置的锚点自检会在控制台 `warn` 一次，而不是静默失效。
- 折叠与 Excel 取值走的是**展示层后处理**，不是内核的官方扩展点。功能正常，但属于「DSH 改版时最先需要复查」的部分。

---

## 实现说明（给维护者和审核者）

这个插件**没有宿主路由、没有额外的 Node 依赖**，宿主半边（`lib/index.js`）是空的 —— 它的存在只是为了在 Loader 里占一行。全部逻辑在 `client.js`（浏览器半边，手写 CJS + `window.__ModuleLoader__` 包装，只有 `require('react')` 一个依赖）。

用到的官方扩展点：

- `sidebar.right.tab.document.actions` —— 工具栏入口（「批注」提示按钮）
- `sidebar.right.tab.files.actions` —— 不摆按钮，只借这个座位拿 `inputActions` / `sessionId` / `draft`
- `inputTriggers.registerSource` —— 输入框胶囊的注册与提交时的序列化编解码
- `conversation.input.for(scope)` → `insertReference(span, ref)` —— 把胶囊插进 Lexical 草稿
- `remote.workspaceFiles.read` / `readBytes` —— 读工作区文件
- `remote.session.openWorkspacePath` —— 「用默认程序打开」，直接复用 DSH 自带的后端

依赖的 DOM 锚点（会自检，失效时 `console.warn`）：

`[data-document-preview]`、`[data-textpreview-body]`、`[data-textpreview-line]`、`[data-textpreview-path]`、`[data-code-preview]`、`[data-document-markdown]`、`[data-pdf-page]`、`.fortune-name-box`、`[data-files-body]`、`[data-files-entry]`、`[data-files-path]`、`[data-files-root]`、`[data-chat-flow-kind]`、`[data-submission-echo]`

两个值得记下来的实现细节：

1. **Excel 选区不能靠 `window.getSelection()`。** 单元格是画在 canvas 上的，文字不在 DOM 里。但 FortuneSheet 会把当前选区写进名称框 `.fortune-name-box` —— 读它就够了。另外它的名称框在「选区焦点格正好是合并单元格左上角」时会**故意塌缩成单个格子**，所以真实范围改从 React 工作簿快照的 `luckysheet_select_save` 里读，名称框只作兜底。
2. **`setDraft` 会抹掉胶囊。** 它会先 `replace(REFERENCE_PLACEHOLDER_RE, '')` 再重建整份草稿，而胶囊正是用这些占位符表示的。所以补文字一律走 `insertText` / `insertReference`，绝不整份重写。

### 调试开关

默认控制台是干净的。需要排查时，在浏览器控制台执行一次：

```js
localStorage.setItem('dsh-file-to-chat:debug', '1')   // 刷新页面后打开细节日志
localStorage.removeItem('dsh-file-to-chat:debug')     // 关回去
```

---

## 开发

源码即产物：`client.js` 是手写的，没有构建步骤。改完保存即可 —— DSH 的 `dsh-client-hmr` 每 500 ms 轮询一次客户端 bundle，会**自动热重载，不用刷新页面**。（宿主半边 `lib/index.js` 不热重载，改了要重启应用；本插件正常情况下不需要动它。）

```
dsh-file-to-chat/
├── package.json         dsh.bundle / dsh.client 声明
├── cordis.patch.yml     往 Loader 里插一行
├── lib/index.js         宿主半边（空实现，只为占位）
└── client.js            浏览器半边 —— 全部功能
```

---

## 仓库与镜像

| 位置 | 角色 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| [gitee.com/mofeo/dsh-file-to-chat](https://gitee.com/mofeo/dsh-file-to-chat) | **开发主仓（权威）** | 提交先落这里；版本号、CHANGELOG 与发布版本以主仓为准 |
| [github.com/feifiefei/dsh-file-to-chat](https://github.com/feifiefei/dsh-file-to-chat) | 镜像 | dsh-plugin.org 的收录页与安装命令指向它，**可能滞后于主仓**，仅供同步与市场发现 |

`package.json` 的 `repository` / `bugs` 指向主仓（npm 的 `repository` 只接受单一仓库），GitHub 镜像另记在 `mirrors.github` 里 —— 这是本项目自定义的字段（和本项目的 `dsh` 字段一样），npm 不会解析它，只供人和脚本读取。

### 从插件市场进来，怎么拿到最新版

[dsh-plugin.org 收录页](https://dsh-plugin.org/zh/plugins/feifiefei/dsh-file-to-chat) 给的是 GitHub 源码安装命令；如果镜像还没同步到最新提交，改用主仓命令装（或把已有安装切到主仓）：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add https://gitee.com/mofeo/dsh-file-to-chat.git
```

---

## 许可

[MIT](LICENSE)

plugins.description: SSH for DeepSeek Harness agents: host address, port, account, password and private key live in an encrypted vault, and the conversation only ever uses an alias. The model never sees a password, and a password never reaches a command line or a remote process list.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-ssh-vault **English** | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md) [![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-yellow.svg)](LICENSE) [![Node](https://img.shields.io/badge/node-%3E%3D20-brightgreen.svg)](package.json) [![DSH plugin](https://img.shields.io/badge/DeepSeek%20Harness-plugin-4f7cff.svg)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai) [![Version](https://img.shields.io/badge/version-1.13.0-informational.svg)](package.json) [![Tests](https://img.shields.io/badge/test-160%20cases-brightgreen.svg)](test) SSH for DeepSeek Harness agents: host address, port, account, password and private key live in an encrypted vault, and the conversation only ever uses an alias. The model never sees a password, and a password never reaches a command line or a remote process list. ## Overview Three capabilities in one plugin: - **Model-facing tools** — `ssh_hosts`, `ssh_run`, `ssh_transfer`, `ssh_probe`, so the agent operates remote hosts by alias. - **Settings UI** — add, edit and delete hosts in Settings → SSH Connections, and test reachability. A password entered there travels in an HTTP body, never through the session log. - **`/hosts` command** — probe hosts and run commands from the conversation without going through the model. Under the hood it drives the local OpenSSH client (`ssh` / `scp`). It does not implement the SSH protocol itself. ## Install ```bash dsh plugin --profile desktop install dsh-ssh-vault ``` From a local checkout. The argument is a path, so `.` works when you are already inside the plugin directory: ```bash # inside the checkout dsh plugin --profile desktop install . # or point at it from elsewhere dsh plugin --profile desktop install ../dsh-ssh-vault # or install from a packed tarball dsh plugin --profile desktop install ./dsh-ssh-vault-.tgz ``` **`--profile` is required.** DSH isolates plugins per profile, and one machine can carry several (`desktop`, `cli`, …). Omitting it falls back to whichever profile is currently default, which is an easy way to install into the wrong place. Confirm the landing spot with: ```bash dsh plugin --profile desktop list ``` **Restart DSH after installing.** Host-side tools and routes are loaded at startup. ### Requirements | Item | Requirement | | --- | --- | | Node | ≥ 20 | | Machine | OpenSSH client installed (`ssh` on PATH) | | Platform | Windows, Linux, macOS | ## Quick start 1. **Install, then restart DSH.** 2. Open **Settings → SSH Connections**, click "Add connection", fill in alias, address, port, account, and choose password or private-key authentication. Each card carries a health dot that is checked automatically: grey = not checked, yellow = checking, green = reachable, red = unreachable. 3. Say something in the conversation, for example: ``` run uptime on kali ``` The model calls `ssh_run` and the result appears as a terminal card. Do not paste passwords into the conversation. A password entered in Settings goes straight into the encrypted vault and never enters the model context. ## Usage ### Model-facing tools | Tool | Purpose | Typical phrasing | | --- | --- | --- | | `ssh_hosts` | Manage the vault (list / show / add / update / remove) | "which hosts do I have", "change kali's note" | | `ssh_run` | Run a command on a host, return stdout and stderr | "check disk usage on kali" | | `ssh_transfer` | Upload or download a file (scp) | "copy this file to /tmp on kali" | | `ssh_probe` | Reachability self-check returning system facts | "is kali still reachable" | **Where to see the result:** calls to `ssh_run`, `ssh_probe` and `ssh_transfer` render as a **terminal card** — a header with "host · command" and a state dot, above a scrollable monospace output area. The dot is blue while running, grey on success, red on failure (including a non-zero exit code). ### Settings UI Settings → SSH Connections provides: - A host list with a health dot per card; hover for detail - Add / edit / delete connections (the alias is editable, credentials move with it) - A "Test connection" button per card, whose result also drives the dot - "Open in file manager" for the vault directory - Password and private-key authentication; a key can be uploaded whole and is written into the vault with its permissions tightened ### The `/hosts` command Start a line with `/` in the composer and the command runs **without going through the model**. ``` /hosts list every host, grouped into online / offline /hosts kali probe one /hosts kali,win10 probe several (either comma form works) /hosts kali; apt update run a command on kali /hosts kali,win10; uptime run on every reachable host ``` - Separators accept both ASCII and full-width forms: `,` and `，`, `;` and `；` - If the text after the semicolon reads as natural language (e.g. "check the disk"), the command **does not run it** and tells you to send that sentence to the conversation instead — command output never reaches the model, so such requests cannot go through the command - Output renders as **two cards**: reachability and command execution, each with its own state dot ## Architecture ### Two halves This is a **Host + Client** plugin; the two halves load through different mechanisms: | Half | Entry | Loading | | --- | --- | --- | | **Host** | `index.js` | Cordis plugin, inserted into the Loader through `cordis.patch.yml` | | **Client** | `client.js` | Browser module, declared via `dsh.client` in `package.json` and injected into the page by the host | The Host half carries every sensitive operation: vault encryption, driving the local `ssh` client, web routes, and the registration of commands and tools. The Client half only renders and collects form input; it never executes a command. ### Data flow ```mermaid flowchart TB subgraph entry [Entry points] chat[Conversation / model tool call] settings[Settings form] cmd["/hosts command"] end subgraph host [Host half — index.js] resolve[Resolve alias → read credentials → build ssh args] vault[(Vault
AES-256-GCM ciphertext)] api["Web routes /ssh-vault/*"] exec[Spawn local ssh / scp] end subgraph client [Client half — client.js] toolcard[Tool terminal card] cmdcard["/hosts double card"] form[Connection form] end proxy[Remote host] chat --> resolve cmd --> resolve settings -->|POST JSON| api form -->|same-origin, document-relative| api api --> vault resolve --> vault resolve --> exec exec -->|stdout / stderr| toolcard exec -->|stdout / stderr| cmdcard exec <--> proxy ``` Three invariants hold across that chain: 1. **A password never reaches a command line** — local ssh receives it through `SSH_ASKPASS`; remote sudo is primed over stdin 2. **Only ciphertext touches disk** — AES-256-GCM, with the data key protected by DPAPI (Windows) or derived from a master passphrase via scrypt 3. **`~/.ssh` is never touched** — `known_hosts` points into the vault directory and `HashKnownHosts` is enabled ## Configuration The plugin has **no user-configurable options**. `config: {}` in `cordis.patch.yml` is an empty object, and the Loader entry `id` is fixed as `ssh-vault`. Behaviour is shaped by the following: | Item | Notes | | --- | --- | | Vault directory | Defaults to `$DSH_HOME/ssh-vault`; `DSH_HOME` is decided by DSH | | Key protection | Windows defaults to `dpapi`; other platforms require a master passphrase (`passphrase` mode) | | Timeouts | `ssh_run` defaults to 120s, adjustable, capped at 30 minutes; commands inside `/hosts` are fixed at 120s | | Health checks | Settings page and `/hosts` probe with a 15s timeout; the background sweep refreshes every 5 minutes | ## API and extension points Host-side services are reached through `ctx.inject` as optional dependencies; a missing service does not fail the plugin, it just disables that capability. ### Model tools (`ctx.tools.register`) | Tool | Key parameters | | --- | --- | | `ssh_hosts` | `action` required (list / show / add / update / remove); `reveal` controls whether address and account are masked | | `ssh_run` | `host

plugins.description: Prompt-cache warmer for DeepSeek Harness: keeps a session provider cache prefix warm during long tool executions. Host plugin, per-provider TTL grid, journal + UTC-day budget.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-warm

Prompt-cache warmer for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness), a host plugin. It keeps a session's provider prompt-cache prefix warm **while, and only while, the session's agent loop is blocked inside a tool execution** (long `bash`, `job_output`, `wait_agent` on teammates, and similar waits).

It re-dispatches the session's **last conversation request** through the host `llm/stream` waterfall with `maxTokens: 1` on a fixed interval, then discards the 1-token response. The tool's result lands on the still-warm prefix, so the next real request bills cache-hit input instead of re-prefilling ~90k tokens at miss price and paying the full TTFT again.

## Why only tool blocks

Measured on this setup (2026-10-17, live probe against `api.mistral.ai`, `zai-glm-5-3`; 50 days of ledgers, 350 sessions):

- **TTL is provider-specific.** Mistral's lasts 5 to 7 min here (hit at 302 s, miss at 424 s, and hits refresh the TTL), which is why the interval table is per provider.
- **Tool and teammate waits resume for sure**, since the loop continues the moment the tool settles. Over 50 days that nets **+$7.15** and about 1 h of TTFT recovered, with zero tail risk.
- **Idle sessions mostly never come back.** 344 of 350 sessions were never resumed, and naive OpenCode-style idle warming nets **−$6.91 / 50 days**. So idle sessions and user-input tools (`ask_user_question`) are **never** warmed here.

A cache hit bills at a 90 % discount on this provider ($1.40/M miss, $0.14/M hit). Each ping costs about $0.014 per 100k-token prefix and saves a ~$0.126 re-prefill plus 25 to 40 s of TTFT when the block outlasts the TTL.

## How the replay stays byte-identical

The loop-built request arrives at the `llm/stream` waterfall deep-frozen, a pure function of the session log. The warmer captures that exact object and later sends a fresh shallow copy that shares the frozen fields, changing only:

- `maxTokens: 1`, a sampling field that is not part of the cached input prefix,
- `signal`, the captured call's signal chained (`AbortSignal.any`) with the ping timeout, so a user interrupt aborts an in-flight ping too.

The same adapter that served the real call serializes the ping, so the input prefix is byte-identical and the provider serves it from cache. This is the same cache-reusing auxiliary-call pattern the harness itself uses for compaction summarization. The ping is a *hand-built* call (the loop's `markAgentLoopRequest` WeakSet identity does not carry over to the copy) and it traverses the full waterfall, so routing adapters behave identically and **dsh-cost-meter bills its usage like any other call**. The ledger stays honest.

## Install

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-warm                      # from npm
dsh plugin --profile web add github:JanEickholt/dsh-warm  # from GitHub, no npm needed
```

Or as a local plugin (link protocol):

1. `profiles/<profile>/package.json`: add `"dsh-warm": "link:/absolute/path/to/dsh-warm"` to `dependencies` and `"dsh-warm"` to `dsh.profile.bundles`.
2. `pnpm install` inside the profile directory.
3. Restart the harness from a terminal (e.g. `systemctl --user restart <your-dsh-unit>`). A restart kills the host process; never trigger it from inside a session.

The plugin's `dsh.bundle.patch` (`cordis.patch.yml`) inserts the loader row automatically; no `cordis.patch.yml` edit needed.

## Configuration

`$DSH_HOME/storages/dsh-warm/config.json` (written with defaults on first load; edit + restart). The ping interval is **per provider**, because the interval must sit under that provider's own prompt-cache TTL:

```json
{
  "enabled": true,
  "dryRun": false,
  "maxPings": 5,
  "providers": {
    "mistral":   { "intervalMs": 240000, "ttlMs": 302000 },
    "openai":    { "intervalMs": 240000, "ttlMs": 300000 },
    "anthropic": { "intervalMs": 240000, "ttlMs": 300000 }
  },
  "excludeTools": ["ask_user_question"],
  "minPrefixChars": 12000,
  "maxConcurrentPings": 2,
  "dailyPingBudget": 300,
  "pingTimeoutMs": 90000,
  "stats": { "enabled": true }
}
```

| field | default | meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `enabled` | `true` | master switch |
| `dryRun` | `false` | journal would-be pings, dispatch nothing. Watch mode for a first deploy. |
| `providers` | see above | **presence in the table = warm this provider**; each entry needs its own `intervalMs` and may override `maxPings` and `ttlMs` |
| `maxPings` | `5` | ping cap per tool block when a provider entry doesn't override it (the prefix is stale past `maxPings × intervalMs` anyway) |
| `excludeTools` | `["ask_user_question"]` | user-idle-like waits with uncertain resume |
| `minPrefixChars` | `12000` | skip tiny prefixes (≈chars/4 tokens); preventing a miss on them is not worth a ping |
| `maxConcurrentPings` | `2` | global in-flight guard; over-cap pings retry in 5 s without consuming a slot |
| `dailyPingBudget` | `300` | hard stop per UTC day, counted over real dispatch attempts (expected need ≈30/day) |
| `pingTimeoutMs` | `90000` | abort a stalled ping stream |
| `providers.*.ttlMs` | adopted per known provider | the provider's cache TTL floor, used by stats classification; `intervalMs` when a provider has no measured value. Warns when `ttlMs <= intervalMs` (the grid can never bridge the TTL) |
| `stats.enabled` | `true` | stats counting + `stats.json` + the `/api/dsh-warm/stats` route's snapshot |

### Why these three providers

Interval defaults are tied to each provider's own cache behavior. Measure before adding more:

- **mistral** was measured on this setup (2026-10-17 live probe, `zai-glm-5-3`): hit at 302 s, miss at 424 s, so 240 s leaves about a minute of headroom.
- **openai** documents its cache as lasting "generally between 5 minutes and up to an hour"; 240 s stays under the short end.
- **anthropic** documents a 5-minute TTL, refreshed on use; 240 s fits.
- **deepseek** is deliberately absent. Its automatic disk cache outlives any sane ping grid (reports range from minutes to hours, and DeepSeek publishes no TTL), so a ping there every 4 minutes is pure waste. Add an entry only after measuring an actual TTL on your account.
- **opencode-go / other proxies** are absent because their TTL is unmeasured. Probe first, then add e.g. `"opencode-go": { "intervalMs": 120000 }"`.

A pre-table config (`warmProviders` + `intervalMs`) migrates automatically into the per-provider table with a console warning.

## Stats

dsh-warm keeps its own ledger of what warming bought and what it wasted, independent of any other plugin. It shows up in three places: a `stats.json` file, a documented HTTP route, and a small client bundle.

**Counters** (kept per UTC day and all-time; `failed` is all-time only):

| counter | meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `warms` | pings dispatched |
| `needless` | wasted: the follow-up request arrived within the provider TTL anyway, so the prefix was still warm without the ping |
| `noFollowup` | wasted: the tool block ended with no follow-up request at all (the turn went idle, or the session was disposed) |
| `expired` | wasted: the follow-up needed the warm prefix but came more than TTL after the last successful ping, so the cache had already dropped |
| `failed` | pings that errored (counted separately, never as waste) |
| `savedCacheTokens` | cache-read tokens of the last successful ping in a block whose follow-up was necessary and arrived within TTL, i.e. what warming verifiably bought |

Approximations, by design: classification compares request/ping timestamps against the configured `ttlMs`, not provider-side cache state. A ping that reported a miss (`cacheReadTokens` 0) is never credited. After a crash (no clean dispose) the boot reseeds `warms`/`failed` from `warm.jsonl` but leaves outcome counters at zero, because outcomes need the follow-up request that happened after the journal line. Stats are written to `storages/dsh-warm/stats.json` (atomic rename, UTC-day buckets).

**Toggle:** `"stats": { "enabled": true }`, on by default. Off means no counting, no `stats.json`, and the route below serves `"statsEnabled": false, "stats": null` so consumers can render the state instead of guessing.

**`GET /api/dsh-warm/st

plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-folding-Windows

让 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）侧边栏的功能区和工作区分别展开或收起，各自记住状态。
支持在工作区内置顶项目，并通过 DSH 的原生排序保存项目顺序。

**DSH 插件类别：** 用户界面与体验（UI/UX）

**许可证：** [MIT](LICENSE)

![默认收起后的独立预览](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Alice-Marx/dsh-folding-Windows/main/docs/folded.png)

## 截图

- [功能区展开](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Alice-Marx/dsh-folding-Windows/main/docs/expanded.png)
- [工作区收起](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Alice-Marx/dsh-folding-Windows/main/docs/workspaces-folded.png)
- [项目置顶](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Alice-Marx/dsh-folding-Windows/main/docs/pinned.png)

## 安装

需要已安装可运行的 DSH CLI 和 pnpm。在终端运行以下命令，将插件安装到 DSH 的 Web 配置：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add @ljwei-stak/dsh-folding-windows
dsh --profile web
```

如果希望直接从 GitHub 源码安装：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:Alice-Marx/dsh-folding-Windows
dsh --profile web
```

将 `web` 替换为使用 Web 界面的其他配置名。重新启动 DSH Web 配置后插件生效；更新或卸载可使用 `dsh plugin --profile web update @ljwei-stak/dsh-folding-windows` 或 `dsh plugin --profile web remove @ljwei-stak/dsh-folding-windows`。

## 支持的配置

- 安装目标：DSH Web 配置（例如 `web`）；通过 DSH 的插件管理命令安装后，由 DSH 更新该配置的依赖清单和 Bundle 列表。
- 插件清单：根目录 [`package.json`](package.json) 声明包名、版本、许可证、最低 DSH 版本及 Web 客户端平台。
- Bundle 配置：[`cordis.patch.yml`](cordis.patch.yml) 将插件的客户端模块加入 DSH 配置。
- 无需新增配置文件、环境变量或 API 密钥。折叠状态和项目置顶偏好按浏览器配置保存在 `localStorage`；清除该站点数据会重置这些偏好。

插件入口导出 `apply(ctx)`，在 DSH 的效果生命周期中安装客户端增强；项目置顶通过 DSH 注入的 `workspaces` 服务调用原生排序能力。

## 权限与数据

- 读取并调整 DSH Web 界面的侧边栏 DOM，添加折叠按钮和样式，并观察界面节点变化以适配动态加载。
- 通过浏览器 `localStorage` 保存两个区域的折叠状态和项目置顶偏好；通过 DSH `workspaces` 服务调整项目顺序。
- 此版本不发起网络请求，不访问文件系统、命令行、环境变量或凭据，也不向外部服务发送数据。
- 停用或卸载并刷新后，插件移除自身样式与按钮、恢复被隐藏的区域；项目顺序保留在 DSH 中。

## 兼容性

- `package.json` 声明的目标为 DSH `>=0.2.0-rc.2`，客户端平台为 `web`。
- 安装运行要求 Node.js `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0`（与 `package.json` 的 `engines.node` 一致）。
- 实测环境包括 DSH Web `0.2.1-rc.2`；针对 `0.2.0-rc.2` 和 `0.2.1-rc.2` 的侧边栏结构也有浏览器夹具验证记录。
- 适用于 Windows 上的 DSH Web 界面及使用相同 Web 界面的部署。不适用于没有 Web 客户端界面的 headless 或 TUI 配置。
- 插件依赖 DSH Web 侧边栏的语义标签和 DOM 结构；若上游调整这些结构，插件可能需要更新适配。

## 使用

- 新增「功能区」按钮，点击即可展开或收起插件、自动化任务、任务看板、技能中心、模型路由、SSH、MV 放映室等入口。
- 新增「工作区」按钮，点击即可展开或收起整个工作区区域，包括其中的搜索、项目和会话列表。
- 功能区首次默认收起，工作区首次默认展开；两个区域的状态分别保存在当前浏览器配置中，刷新后保留。
- 新增或卸载其他插件时，功能入口数量自动更新。
- 支持 Tab 聚焦及 Enter / 空格操作；收起的入口不会进入 Tab 顺序。
- 收起整个侧边栏后，功能区开关随之隐藏；重新打开侧边栏时恢复原状态。
- 支持中文、英文以及 DSH 的深浅色主题。

## 项目置顶

在「按工作区」或「按工作区树」视图中，鼠标移到项目行，点击图钉即可置顶；已置顶项目保留图钉，点击可取消置顶。也可用 Tab 聚焦图钉后按 Enter 或空格。

- 多个置顶项目按最近置顶在前排列，刷新后保留；重命名不影响置顶记录。
- 项目和其所属会话一起排序；树形视图保留父子层级，在同级项目中优先显示置顶项。
- 取消置顶恢复本插件记录的普通顺序。项目置顶与两个区域的折叠状态分别保存。
- 纯会话视图没有项目行；切回工作区视图即可使用图钉。
- 置顶偏好保存在当前浏览器，项目顺序由 DSH 持久化。停用插件时保留当前项目顺序。

禁用或卸载本插件并刷新后，原来的功能入口和工作区恢复显示。存储不可用时仍可折叠，但刷新后回到各区域的默认状态。

## 开发与验证

无需运行时依赖，不修改 DSH 本体文件，不发送网络请求。通过官方客户端插件入口加载，使用「全局面板 / Global panels」「新建会话 / New session」「搜索会话 / Search sessions」等语义标签与侧边栏结构定位区域，保留 DSH 原有节点和点击行为。DSH 如果调整这些标签或结构，插件会停止增强，需适配后才能继续折叠。

```sh
npm ci
npx playwright install chromium
npm run build
npm run check
npm test
npm run preview
```

浏览器测试使用与官方侧边栏结构一致的夹具，覆盖折叠、展开、刷新记忆、动态入口、重挂、重复启用及卸载恢复。预览页面仅用于演示和测试，不是完整 DSH 应用。

源码位于 `src/`，项目排序逻辑和项目行按钮分别位于 `pin-controller.js`、`project-pins.js`。构建将源码合并，包装为 DSH 要求的 `window.__ModuleLoader__.load({ id, factory })` 模块，产物为 `lib/client.js`。

## 许可

MIT

# dsh-milestone-guard **阶段性结论软强制守卫插件（Milestone Progress Soft-Enforcement Guard for DeepSeek Harness）** `dsh-milestone-guard` 是一个面向 **DeepSeek Harness (DSH)** 的轻量级 Cordis 插件。它通过 **「System Prompt 常驻规范注入 + `tools/post-execute` 瀑布流软强制纠偏提醒 + GUI 可视化热更新配置」** 的机制，解决思考模型（Reasoning Models）在长链路 Agent 任务中常见的两大痛点： 1. **黑盒静默调用工具（Silent Tool Calling）**：模型将所有推理过程隐藏在 `` 块内，随后直接跳到 `` 发起数十次工具调用而不输出任何人类可见正文；当 GUI 默认折叠思考过程时，用户只能看到一排工具刷屏，无法获知上一步验证的结论或下一步意图。 2. **纯文本汇报导致回合误判中断（Premature Turn Termination）**：当开发者在 Prompt 中要求模型“汇报阶段性进展”时，模型容易单独输出一条不带工具调用的纯文本消息，导致 Agent 主循环误判当前回合（Turn）已结束而提前停顿。 ![阶段性结论守卫真实运行效果](assets/screenshot-1-guard-flow.png) ![阶段性结论守卫插件配置界面](assets/screenshot-2-settings.png) --- ## 核心效果对比 (Before vs. After) | 场景 | 未启用 `dsh-milestone-guard` | 启用 `dsh-milestone-guard` 后 | | :--- | :--- | :--- | | **连续工具调用时** | 模型从 `` 直接跳到 ``、``，界面只见工具刷屏，没有任何阶段性结论。 | 发起工具调用前自动附带 1~2 句简明人类可见结论（如：“*已确认配置文件入口，接下来检查中间件注册逻辑*”）。 | | **中途汇报进展时** | 模型单独发送一段纯文本总结而不带工具调用，导致 Agent 循环直接中断等待用户输入。 | 强制要求**阶段性结论必须与下一步工具调用（或 `todo_write`）在同一回复中并发发出**，长链路一气呵成。 | | **长链路注意力衰减时** | 随着上下文增长，模型逐渐遗忘 System Prompt 规范，恢复静默调用工具。 | `tools/post-execute` 自动检测静默步并在 `additionalContexts` 前置注入 `notice` 软提醒，下一轮立即恢复规范输出，且**不打断、不浪费当前工具执行结果**。 | --- ## 工作原理 (Architecture) ```mermaid flowchart LR A["1. System Prompt 常驻注入
ctx.systemPrompt.section"] --> B["LLM 生成回复
(Thought + Text? + Tool Calls)"] B --> C["2. 工具执行后拦截
ctx.on('tools/post-execute')"] C --> D{"最新 assistant/message
是否包含非空可见 Text 块?"} D -- "是 (合规)" --> E["重置连续静默计数
原样透传 downstream"] D -- "否 (漏发阶段性结论)" --> F{"WeakMap (agent, turn, step)
同一步去重 & maxSilentSteps 检查"} F -- "同一步已提醒 / 未超容忍步数" --> E F -- "触发纠偏" --> G["前置注入 notice 提醒至
downstream.additionalContexts"] ``` ### 关键技术设计 * **零损耗软强制（Non-blocking Soft Enforcement）**：不在 `tools/pre-execute` 阶段粗暴阻断（`block`）工具执行，而是让工具正常执行完毕后，在 `tools/post-execute` 阶段向 `downstream.additionalContexts` 前置附加一条 `notice` 提醒消息，兼顾执行效率与纠偏效果。 * **步级并发去重与防内存泄漏**：当模型在同一个 `(turn, step)` 中并发调用多个工具（如同时调用 5 次 `read`）时，基于 `WeakMap` 按 `(agent, turn, step)` 去重，确保同一步只评估并注入一次提醒，且随 Agent 实例销毁自动回收内存。 * **GUI 可视化配置与 `.volatile()` 热更新**：内置客户端配置组件（[`lib/client.js`]()），在 DeepSeek Harness「插件 → 已安装 → 阶段性结论守卫」页面直接提供可视化配置表单，修改后无需重启会话即可实时生效。 * **零外部强依赖与多版本兼容**： * 自动兼容 `session.events`（数组属性）、`session.snapshotEvents()`（DSH 0.1.5+ / 0.2.0+ 方法）与 `session.log`； * 对 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm` 和 `@deepseek-ai/schemastery` 提供宿主动态解析与内置零依赖 Fallback（含 `toJSON()` 与 Standard Schema `~standard` 协议），可在纯 Node.js 环境独立运行和测试。 --- ## 安装与配置 (Installation & Configuration) ### 方式一：在 DeepSeek Harness GUI 中安装与可视化配置 1. 在 DeepSeek Harness「**插件 (Plugins)** → **添加插件**」中填入本地路径或仓库地址进行安装。 2. 点击「**插件** → **已安装** → **阶段性结论守卫 (`dsh-milestone-guard`)**」，即可在详情面板中直接修改： * **最大连续静默步数 (`maxSilentSteps`)** * **System Prompt 排序权重 (`sectionOrder`)** * **自定义软强制提醒文案 (`reminderText`)** ### 方式二：在 `cordis.patch.yml` 中配置 ```yaml - id: milestone-guard name: dsh-milestone-guard config: enabled: true locale: zh sectionOrder: 180 maxSilentSteps: 0 ignoreTools: [] ``` --- ## 配置项说明 (Configuration Options) | 配置项 | 类型 | 默认值 | 说明 | | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | | `enabled` | `boolean` | `true` | 是否启用本插件。 | | `locale` | `'zh' \| 'en'` | `'zh'` | 内置 System Prompt 规范与软强制提醒文本的语言预设（支持中英双语开箱即用）。 | | `sectionOrder` | `number` | `180` | 注入到 System Prompt 的段落排序权重（支持 GUI 热更新，数值越小位置越靠前）。 | | `maxSilentSteps` | `number` | `0` | 允许模型连续多少步仅调用工具而不输出可见结论（支持 GUI 热更新）。默认 `0` 表示每步必报（当步漏发立即提醒）；设为 `N`（如 `2`）表示允许连续静默 `2` 步，第 `3` 步仍无正文时才触发提醒（即每 `N+1` 步至少汇报一次）。同时支持别名 `everySteps: N`（自动换算为 `maxSilentSteps: N - 1`）。 | | `ignoreTools` | `string[]` | `[]` | 忽略的工具名称列表（例如 `["todo_write"]`）。当某一步仅调用了列表内的工具时，不触发漏发阶段性结论提醒。 | | `promptText` | `string` | *(内置预设)* | 自定义注入到 System Prompt 的规范正文；留空时自动使用 `locale` 对应的内置预设。 | | `reminderText` | `string` | *(内置预设)* | 自定义检测到静默工具调用时注入的软提醒文本（支持 GUI 热更新）；留空或恢复默认时使用内置预设。 | --- ## 开发与测试 (Development & Testing) 本项目使用 Node.js 原生测试运行器（`node:test`），无需安装额外测试框架即可验证全部核心行为： ```bash npm test ``` ## License [MIT]()

plugins.description: Out-of-tree patch: make @deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client recover when a stateful Streamable HTTP MCP server restarts, instead of failing until DSH is restarted.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-mcp-session-recovery

An out-of-tree patch that makes `@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client` recover when a
**stateful Streamable HTTP MCP server stops recognising the session** underneath
a running DSH — whether because the server restarted, or because an idle timeout
pruned the session while everything stayed up.

Without it, every tool from that server fails permanently — restarting DSH is
the only fix. With it, the client notices the dead session and rebuilds the
connection on its own within a second or two.

> **中文摘要**：当带会话状态的 MCP 服务端（Streamable HTTP）不再认识 DSH 手里那个
> `mcp-session-id` 时（服务端重启，**或会话因空闲超时被清理**），该服务端的
> **所有工具调用会永久失败**，只能靠重启 DSH 恢复。本仓库是一个仓外补丁，让客户端
> 自己发现会话失效并重连，1~2 秒内自愈。
>
> ⚠️ 注意一个常见误解：**并不需要服务端重启**。实测有服务端把会话持久化到磁盘、重启
> 完全无损，但设有 12 小时空闲超时 —— 只要 DSH 挂着超过 12 小时没有 MCP 调用，
> 同样会中招。详见下文。
>
> 上游已知（见下方链接），官方暂不接受外部 PR，故以此形式发布。

## The bug

`dsh-mcp-client` has a complete reconnect supervisor — bounded exponential
backoff, outage-scoped attempt budget, tool re-sync on reconnect. It is wired to
exactly one signal:

```js
generation.onclose = () => { ... if (attemptSettled) generationDown(generation) }
```

Session loss never produces a close. The MCP SDK reports it as a **request-level
error**: the transport throws `SdkHttpError` with `status: 404` and calls
`onerror` only, leaving `onclose` silent. The dead `mcp-session-id` is retained,
because the SDK rewrites it only on a *successful handshake* — and handshakes
happen only inside `connectGeneration()`, which only runs at startup or after a
reconnect.

So:

```
the server no longer recognises our mcp-session-id
  → client still holds the old id
  → next tool call → HTTP 404
  → SDK fires onerror (NOT onclose)
  → dsh-mcp-client subscribes to no onerror → signal dropped
  → no reconnect, no new handshake, session id never replaced
  ⇒ permanent failure for the life of the Host process
```

Starting a new conversation does **not** help: the MCP bridge is process-scoped,
one plugin instance per Host, shared by every session. Only a Host restart does.

A telling asymmetry: a *failed connect attempt* **does** reach the supervisor
(`settleFailedGeneration → generationDown → scheduleReconnect`), so a server that
is down at startup keeps being retried. Only a session invalidated on an
**already-established** connection falls through the gap.

### What invalidates a session depends on the server

Both variants produce the same 404 and the same permanent failure, so the patch
is the same — but the trigger is worth knowing, because it determines how often
you hit this:

| server behaviour | trigger | notes |
|---|---|---|
| sessions held in memory | process restart | the classic case |
| **sessions persisted and restored** | **idle timeout** | a restart is harmless; long idleness is not |

The second variant is the one verified end-to-end here. Nowledge Mem's backend
logs

```
MCP session idle timeout and restart restore store configured
  seconds=43200                                    # 12 hours
  store_path=…/co.nowledge.mem.desktop/mcp-sessions.json
```

and indeed a session survives repeated server restarts (confirmed: an MCP session
created before two consecutive app restarts still answered `200` afterwards),
while one aged past 43200s is pruned and rejected with
`404 Not Found: Session not found`.

**Practical consequence:** leaving DSH running for more than 12 hours without an
MCP call is enough to break the connection — no crash, no restart, nothing
visible. That is far easier to hit than a server crash, and it is exactly this
shape of failure that is invisible without the patch.

## Affected versions

`lib/index.js` is byte-identical across these, so the same patch applies to both:

| version | `lib/index.js` sha256 | affected |
|---|---|---|
| `@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client@0.2.0-rc.2` | `758d8fc4…f5dd` | yes |
| `@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client@0.2.1-alpha.4` | `758d8fc4…f5dd` | yes |

`grep -c onerror lib/index.js` → `0` on both.

## Install

```bash
git clone https://github.com/MaxHou-infinity/dsh-mcp-session-recovery
cd dsh-mcp-session-recovery
./apply.sh
```

The script finds the installed plugin, refuses to proceed if the file does not
match the revision the patch was cut against (unless you confirm), backs the
original up to `~/.dsh/backups/dsh-mcp-client-pre-onerror-fix/`, applies the
patch in a scratch repo so a partial application cannot land, and syntax-checks
the result. It is idempotent.

Then restart DSH:

```bash
kill $(lsof -ti tcp:3080 -sTCP:LISTEN); dsh web
```

## Verify

**Reproduce the bug and the fix offline**, with no DSH restart and no real MCP
server — a fake stateful server invalidates its session mid-flight:

```bash
node test/run.mjs /path/to/.../dsh-mcp-client/lib/index.js
```

It prints `RECOVERED` (patched) or `STUCK` (unpatched). Run it against the
backup to see the control.

**Verify the real thing** — with DSH running and its MCP tools working,
invalidate the session, then call a tool:

- first call fails with `404 Session not found` (expected — that is the trigger)
- **within a second or two, calls succeed again with no DSH restart**

Before this patch the second step never happened.

### Result from the end-to-end run this patch was built on

Against a real DSH host (0.2.0-rc.2) and a real Nowledge Mem backend, stopping
the session by aging it past the server's 43200s idle timeout:

| step | observed |
|---|---|
| first tool call | `Error POSTing to endpoint: Not Found: Session not found` |
| server session store, ~8s later | a **new** `dsh-mcp-client` session id appears |
| second tool call | succeeds |

No DSH restart in between. The server-side session store is the useful witness
here: a new entry appearing on its own is proof that a fresh `initialize`
handshake happened, which only the reconnected generation performs.

To invalidate a session the same way for a persisted-session server, stop the
server, age the entry in its session store, and start it again — mutating a live
store is pointless, because the running server holds the session in memory.

## What the patch changes

Two additions, ~35 lines, no behaviour change on any other path:

1. `isSessionLostError(error)` — a deliberately narrow predicate: `status === 404`
   (which the transport only produces for a request that carried a session id),
   plus `400` whose body names the session as missing/invalid/unknown/expired.
   Anything else surfaces unchanged, so ordinary request errors never recycle a
   healthy generation.
2. `generation.onerror = (error) => { if (attemptSettled && isSessionLostError(error)) generationDown(generation) }`
   — funnels session loss into the same disconnect path `onclose` already uses.
   Everything downstream (backoff, fresh handshake, tool re-sync) is the existing,
   unmodified machinery.

## Uninstall

```bash
./revert.sh          # restores from the newest backup
```

Reinstalling or upgrading DSH also reverts it — this patch lives inside the
globally installed `@deepseek-ai/dsh` package and is **not** preserved across a
DSH upgrade. Re-run `./apply.sh` after upgrading if the bug is still present
(check with `grep -c onerror lib/index.js`).

## Why this is not an upstream PR

The official repository does not accept them. From
[CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md):

> We are sorry that we cannot accept external pull requests at the moment.

and the repo's PR API returns `404` — pull requests are disabled, as are issues.
The policy instead points contributors at Discussions and at the ecosystem:

> We do not believe that packages in the official repository are inherently more
> important than packages created by the community.

So this is published as an out-of-tree patch rather than a fork. The upstream
report lives at
[deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness#9740](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/9740);
if the maintainers adopt a fix, this repository retires.

## License

MIT. The patch modifies MIT-licensed code, Copyright (c) 2026 DeepSeek; the
patch file and scripts here are provided under the same terms.

plugins.readme_text:
# 蜂医桌宠 · `dsh-medic-pet`

DeepSeek Harness 插件：一只住在页面角落的养成系桌宠 —— **Q 版战地医护**形象 + **逐轮 token 用量播报** +
**本机统计 / 每日任务 / 勋章 / 守护提醒**，养成速度**以天为单位**。
它只读这张页面已经观察到的用量：**不发网络、不读凭据、不查余额、不编造金额**。

![五个阶段、三种情绪、三档尺寸与四套主题的对照图](docs/preview.png)

功能起点是社区挂件 `dsh-whale-widget`（桌面挂件 + 逐轮用量）；形象、代码与玩法都是重画原创。

> **同人声明**：形象以一张玩家社群表情包的人脸为**风格参考**（深色上扬短发、粗眉、蓝眼睛、下巴胡茬、浅灰绿上衣；那张照片本身不在仓库里，也没有被描摹进 SVG），装备部分沿用《三角洲行动》蜂医的气质与配色（黑色头戴耳机 + 绿色几何徽记、夹克、胸挂、胸口医疗包与三支针剂、腰间棱纹罐、深灰手套配青绿指节）。
> 画面全部由本插件用 SVG 路径手画，**没有使用、内嵌或分发任何官方素材、立绘、照片或图片**；不使用受保护的红十字标识（臂章与图标都是白/绿十字）；包名 `dsh-medic-pet` 与角色名称均为自定义，非官方产品。形象素材的补充声明单独放在 [`NOTICE.md`](NOTICE.md)。

## 它能做什么

### 用量与养成

| 能力 | 说明 |
| --- | --- |
| 逐轮用量气泡 | 每轮回答结束后播报本轮 `输入 / 输出`（有缓存时追加缓存读、缓存写），延迟 700 ms 结算以等尾部用量落定 |
| 今日累计 | 按本地日期分桶累计，气泡与面板都标注「本页观察累计」，不谎称账号全量 |
| 养成（按天） | **当天观察到至少一轮用量 → 计入 1 天**；累计天数决定阶段：新兵 0 → 见习医护 2 → 战地医护 5 → 高级医护 10 → 医护队长 20 天。相邻日期连着算「连续 N 天」 |
| 阶段装备 | 肩章 → 针剂架 + 悬停医疗无人机 → 腰间棱纹罐 + 绿十字臂章 → 光环 + 金色头带饰 |
| 情绪 | 刚有动静眯眼笑；两分钟无动静犯困（闭眼 + `z`）；其余为待机，眉眼带一点「?」的困惑感 |

### 数据面板（齿轮里）

| 能力 | 说明 |
| --- | --- |
| 累计与峰值 | 本机累计 tokens / 轮数，单轮最高、单日最高（含日期） |
| 今日 vs 昨天 | 环比百分比；昨天没记录时直说「昨天没有记录」，不编基数 |
| 趋势柱状图 | 7 天 / 30 天切换，逐日本地观察量；只保留最近 60 天 |
| 阶段进度条 | 当前阶段内已走的天数与下一阶所需天数 |
| 复制统计 | 把本机统计（天数、累计、峰值、勋章、历史）以 JSON 写进剪贴板；剪贴板不可用时退化成可全选复制的文本框 |

### 玩法

| 能力 | 说明 |
| --- | --- |
| 每日任务 | 同一天目标由**日期决定**（不是随机）：推进 N 轮（3/5/8）+ 用掉 M tokens（2万/5万/10万）+ 互动一次。三项齐 → 记 1 个「全勤日」 |
| 勋章 13 枚 | 第一天 / 连着三天 / 七日同行 / 十天 / 二十天 / 单轮破万 / 单日五万 / 累计百万 / 摸头五十 / 互动一百 / 三日全勤 + 事件两枚「夜班」（23:00–05:00 第一次用量）「起早」（05:00–07:00）。**只由观察到的数字解锁，一旦拿到不回收** |
| 互动 5 种 | 摸头、补给（这两个每天各一次）；分享、敬礼、搭话（可重复，搭话换一句情境台词）。**只影响情绪、计数与勋章，永远不加成长值** |
| 情境台词 | 按当前时段（深夜/清晨/白天/夜里/收工）从台词池里挑一句，中英各一份 |

### 守护与外观

| 能力 | 说明 |
| --- | --- |
| 久坐提醒 | 连续在岗 ≥50 分钟且静置 ≥150 秒时提醒起身；真的离开过（≥5 分钟）就重新开始计时 |
| 喝水提醒 | 距上次 ≥45 分钟提醒补给一次 |
| 今日线（预算） | 预设 5万 / 10万 / 20万 / 50万 tokens，超过只提醒一次；`—` 为关闭。**只是本地提示，不是余额、不是金额** |
| 提醒节流 | 两条提醒之间至少隔 20 分钟；正在出活（静置 <150 秒）时不打扰 |
| 主题换装 | 橄榄 / 沙色 / 夜巡 / 医护白，只改夹克、裤子、胸挂、臂章配色，人物特征（发色、瞳色、肤色）不动 |
| 改名 | 面板里直接改桌宠名字（≤12 字），出现在标题与面板抬头 |
| 隐藏 | 收成一个角落小圆点（白/绿十字），点它或再按一次快捷键唤回；隐藏期间不弹提醒 |
| 快捷键 | `Alt+Shift+M` 开/关面板 · `Alt+Shift+B` 气泡开关 · `Alt+Shift+H` 隐藏/唤回 · `Esc` 关面板 |
| 拖拽吸附 | 按住拖动，距任一边 ≤64 px 自动吸边；吸到**左边**时形象镜像翻转，气泡/面板始终朝画面内侧 |
| 两步重置 | 「重置全部」需要点两次确认（第二次按钮变成「确认重置？」），确认才清天数、统计与勋章；「清空今日」只清当天 |

## 明确不做

- 不查询余额，不访问任何网络，不读取 `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY` / 登录态 / Cookie。
- 不折叠原始会话事件：只消费 Host 已经接好的 `tokenUsage` / `sessionStats` 投影。
- 不显示金额：没有官方单价依据，就不编造「花了多少钱」；「今日线」是 token 数，不是钱。
- 不为了留存率造假：没有用量的一天就是没有成长——不补签、不倒计时、不发零；任务与勋章只认本机观察到的数字。

## 数据与持久化

浏览器 `localStorage`，插件自有键（全部只在本机）：

- `dsh.medicPet.v2.settings` → `{ size, bubble, theme, name, budget, breaks, water, hidden }`
- `dsh.medicPet.v2.state` →
  `{ daysUsed, streak, lastActiveDay, pos{x,y,edge}, today{day,input,output,cacheRead,cacheWrite,turns,pat,feed,pats,feeds,treats,salutes,chats,night,early,warned,quests},
     history[{d,t,n}]（≤60 天）, totalIn, totalOut, totalCache, totalTurns, bestTurn, bestDay, bestDayKey,
     badges{id:时间戳}, counts{pats,feeds,treats,salutes,chats,nudges}, perfectDays, lastPerfectDay,
     sitStart, waterAt, lastNudgeAt }`

字段是**增量式**加进来的：读到旧记录时缺什么补什么（`history` 补空数组、`counts` 补 0、非法值夹回范围），不会另开新键，也不会因为版本升级丢位置。

从 v1（按轮好感）升级时：v1 的好感数**不折算**成天数（量纲不同，折了就是编数据），只把「今天已经用过」记为第 1 天，同时保留位置与设置；v1 的键读取后不再写入。

首次装载只立基线、不追溯历史，所以刚打开页面时不会把整段会话累计算成「本轮」。
跨日自动重开今日桶；结算窗口内若又推进了几轮，今日轮数按实际推进的轮数记，气泡显示「近 N 轮」。
投影缺失（该页面没有 `useProjection`）时面板会直接说明，而不是显示假的 0。

## 装载位置

- `shell.overlay` → 可见桌宠（根作用域浮动层，可拖拽，`id: medic-pet`，`order: 900`）。
- `conversation.composer.dock` → 不可见用量桥（会话作用域，读投影后 `return null`，`id: medic-pet.usage`）。

两者共享一个模块闭包内的 store，经 `useSyncExternalStore` 更新；界面色只取 `--dsw-alias-*` 主题令牌，
字面色只用于画面本体，因此深色/浅色都跟随主题。`inject: ['slots','locale']`，仅 `require('react')`。

## 已知限制

- 「今日累计」与所有统计只统计**这个页面开着时**观察到的轮次；刷新前、别的客户端里的消耗不在其中。
- 同时打开多个会话时，各会话独立立基线、各自结算本轮增量；天数、今日累计与历史合并入账。
- 一轮如果没有产生新的 token（增量为 0），不会计入轮数，也不会把当天算成活跃日。
- 一天只在**第一次观察到用量**时记一次；同一天开多少个标签页都只算 1 天（共享同一个 `localStorage` 键）。
- 历史柱状图按本地日期分桶，跨时区旅行或改系统时间会改变分桶结果（插件不做服务器校时）。
- 提醒依赖标签页在前台被渲染：`setInterval` 在后台标签页会被浏览器降频，静置判定因此偏保守。
- 挂件浮在框架最上层，拖到界面控件上会遮挡；吸边、隐藏或拖开即可。

## 安装

零运行时依赖，也没有构建步骤。装进你的 Harness profile：

**1 · 让 DSH 助手装（最省事）**

对你的 Harness 说一句：

> 用 `plugin_manager` 把 `github:zeheng723/dsh-medic-pet` 安装成 bundle（本地目录就给绝对路径），装完把结果告诉我。

它走的是 profile 自己的包管理器。Desktop profile 由应用独占管理，终端里的 `dsh plugin` 会被拒绝，所以别在命令行试这条路。

**2 · 命令行（非 Desktop profile）**

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile <profile名> add github:zeheng723/dsh-medic-pet
dsh plugin --profile <profile名> add "C:\path\to\dsh-medic-pet"   # 从本地 clone 装
```

**3 · 装完之后：刷新一次 Harness 页面**

客户端半在浏览器里注册槽位，`pnpm run dev:web` 没在跑时不会热更新；替换已在跑的包需要重启才会换掉 JS 模块世代。
刷新后角落就该出现这只桌宠 —— 齿轮里是面板，按住可以拖动，距边 64 px 内自动吸边。

数据只存在浏览器 `localStorage` 的插件自有键里，卸载插件不会自动清它们；想清空就用面板里的「重置全部」（两步确认），
或直接删键 `dsh.medicPet.v2.state` 与 `dsh.medicPet.v2.settings`。

## 开发自检

```powershell
npm run check     # node --check：client.js / index.js 语法
npm test          # 无头冒烟 + 文案审计
npm run preview   # 生成 preview.html / preview.svg 对照图（生成物已 gitignore）
npm run banner    # 生成 docs/social-preview.png 的源页 banner.html（横幅成品已入库）
```

- `smoke.mjs` 用桩替换 React / DOM / localStorage / 定时器 / `Date`，因此在无浏览器环境下也能把「51 分钟后久坐提醒会响、20 分钟内不重复响」这类时间逻辑跑成**真断言**；覆盖装载、按天养成、v1 迁移、逐轮结算、统计/勋章/任务、主题落盘并重绘、隐藏态、导出的两条路径、拖拽吸附、快捷键、两步重置，最后遍历一遍全部按钮确认没有处理器抛异常。
- `audit.mjs` 检查 ZH/EN 键数对齐、无重复、无缺键、无死键、`{占位符}` 一致。
- 更多约定见 [`CONTRIBUTING.md`](CONTRIBUTING.md)，尤其：不引入外部素材、不新增网络或凭据访问、界面色只用主题令牌、数据诚实优先于留存率。

## 许可

[MIT](LICENSE)。代码与形象用的手写 SVG 均为本仓库原创；形象只是借用玩家社群二创的气质参考，与相关游戏厂商无关联、未获授权，
MIT 授权只覆盖本仓库的原创代码与原创绘制，不覆盖任何第三方 IP —— 这段说明放在 [`NOTICE.md`](NOTICE.md)（`LICENSE` 保持纯 MIT 正文，
GitHub 才能把许可证识别成 MIT）。fork 或转发时请把两个文件一起保留。

plugins.description: Windows: turns DSH into a desktop app. A one-click launcher and tray controller, plus a sidebar button that splits DSH and chat.deepseek.com side by side with its own taskbar button.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-oneclick-desktop

把 DSH 变成一个**桌面应用**。三个东西，装一次全都有：

| | 功能 |
|---|---|
| 🖥️ **桌面启动** | 双击桌面图标启动 DSH —— 服务、无边框窗口、托盘，一步到位 |
| 🐋 **托盘控制** | 托盘菜单：打开 / 重启 / 状态 / 退出 |
| ⚡ **chat 分屏** | 侧边栏一键把 DSH 和 `chat.deepseek.com` 并排，`Ctrl+Alt+D` 收起/拉出 |

> **Windows only.** 分屏功能用 Win32 API 摆布真实窗口，托盘和快捷方式也是 Windows 机制。
> 其他平台装上去会给出明确提示，不会静默失败。

```
┌────────────────────────┬──────────────┐
│                        │              │
│      DSH  (左 2/3)     │  chat.deep   │
│                        │  seek (右 1/3)│
│                        │              │
└────────────────────────┴──────────────┘
   点侧边栏按钮出现 →  Ctrl+Alt+D 收起 / 拉出
```

## 安装

前提：**Windows**，装有 **Microsoft Edge** 或 **Google Chrome**，DSH ≥ `0.2.0-rc.2`。

在 DSH 侧边栏的「插件」页点 **Add plugin**，填入：

```
dsh-oneclick-desktop
```

或者：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-oneclick-desktop
dsh plugin --profile web add github:MKInori/dsh-oneclick-desktop
```

装完**刷新页面**（`Ctrl+Shift+R`）。桌面集成在插件加载时自动完成，见下。

> **首次仍需手动装一次 DSH。** 启动器的用途是"双击图标启动 DSH"，而它由 DSH 插件安装 ——
> 这是鸡生蛋，绕不过去。装好之后图标才存在。

## 它会往你的桌面上放什么

安装插件时，宿主半会跑一次 `lib/desktop.ps1 -Mode install`：

| 动作 | 位置 |
|---|---|
| 复制启动器脚本到**稳定目录** | `~/.dsh/dsh-oneclick-desktop/launcher/` |
| 创建桌面快捷方式 | `桌面\DSH.lnk` → 指向上面那个目录 |
| 注册 URL 协议 | `HKCU\Software\Classes\dshsplit` |

> 为什么要复制一份：插件更新会**替换整个包目录**，快捷方式不能指向那里，否则一升级就断。
> 稳定目录不受插件更新影响。

**撤销全部三样**：

```powershell
powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File ~\.dsh\plugins\dsh-oneclick-desktop\plugin\lib\desktop.ps1 -Mode remove
```

**只看当前状态**：把 `-Mode remove` 换成 `-Mode status`。

## 使用

**桌面启动**：双击桌面上的 DSH 图标。它会启动服务（若未运行）、打开无边框窗口、出现托盘图标。

**托盘菜单**：右键托盘图标 —— 打开 DSH / 重启 DSH / 查看状态 / 退出。

**chat 分屏**：

| 想做什么 | 怎么做 |
|---|---|
| 打开分屏 | 点侧边栏 **DeepSeek** 按钮 |
| 收起 chat（DSH 全屏） | `Ctrl+Alt+D` |
| 拉出 chat（恢复分屏） | 再按 `Ctrl+Alt+D` |
| 真正关闭 chat | 再点一次按钮（此时文字是「关闭 chat.deepseek」） |

第一次打开会稍慢（要冷启动浏览器窗口并等页面渲染完），**这是刻意的**：
插件等 chat 渲染好才让 DSH 让出空间，所以**你不会看到白屏或者空白区域**。

## 为什么要开独立窗口，而不是嵌在 DSH 里

`chat.deepseek.com` 返回 `content-security-policy: frame-ancestors 'none'`，
**浏览器会强制拒绝任何页面把它 iframe 进来**。所以"在 DSH 内嵌一个面板"这条路在技术上不存在。

这个插件的做法是：两个独立窗口，但可见区域精确贴合，看起来像一个整体的两栏。

## ⚠️ 它会做什么（装之前请读）

插件分两半：**客户端半**是页面上的按钮；**宿主半跑在 DSH 的宿主进程里，以你的权限执行**。
DSH 的工具审批**不会沙箱化插件代码**。宿主半具体会：

| 行为 | 细节 |
|---|---|
| **改你的桌面和注册表** | 创建 `桌面\DSH.lnk`，写 `HKCU\Software\Classes\dshsplit`（都在上面的「撤销」里可一键清除） |
| **启动 PowerShell 进程** | 执行 `lib/window.ps1`、`lib/desktop.ps1`、`launcher/DSH-Tray.ps1`（都随包发布，可自行审阅） |
| **操作窗口** | 通过 `user32.dll` 移动 / 缩放 / 显示隐藏窗口，并写入窗口的 `AppUserModelID` 属性以合并任务栏按钮 |
| **打开浏览器** | 用 Edge/Chrome 打开 `chat.deepseek.com`，使用**独立 profile**（`~/.dsh/edge-deepseek-profile`），与你的日常浏览器配置隔离 |
| **启动 DSH 服务** | 托盘在服务未运行时执行 `dsh web --no-open` |
| **读写本地文件** | 往 `~/.dsh/` 写状态文件 `dsh-oneclick-desktop.state` 和日志 `dsh-oneclick-desktop.log` |
| **监听热键** | 通过 `RegisterHotKey` 占用全局 `Ctrl+Alt+D`（**只在 chat 开着时**，关闭后立即释放） |

**它不会**：读取或上传你的任何文件内容、访问除 `chat.deepseek.com` 以外的网络地址、触碰你的日常浏览器 profile、修改 DSH 安装目录。

**它不能**：在 DSH 里嵌页面（CSP 禁止）、跨平台运行。

## 排错

| 现象 | 原因 / 处理 |
|---|---|
| 桌面图标没出现 | 跑一次 `lib\desktop.ps1 -Mode status` 看三项状态；`-Mode install` 可重跑（幂等） |
| 点了按钮没反应 | 看 `~/.dsh/dsh-oneclick-desktop.log`，宿主把每次请求和脚本输出都写进去了 |
| 分屏四周有缝 | 窗口边框宽度会随窗口状态变化；把 DSH 最大化再点一次按钮即可重新计算 |
| 任务栏又出现两个图标 | 归组是在每次打开时施加的；关掉 chat 重开一次 |
| 按钮不见了 | DSH 侧边栏改版可能让 DOM 挂载点失效；刷新页面，或到「插件」页确认插件是启用状态 |
| `Ctrl+Alt+D` 不生效 | 被别的软件占了，看日志确认 |
| 托盘不出现 | 确认 `~/.dsh/dsh-oneclick-desktop/launcher/DSH-Tray.ps1` 存在；用 `-Mode install` 重装 |
| 提示找不到浏览器 | 装了 Edge 或 Chrome 吗？都在标准位置的话应该能自动找到 |

**一个已知行为**：插件**不干预你自己的窗口操作**。如果你手动把 DSH 最大化或拖到别处，
它不会自动纠正。按两次 `Ctrl+Alt+D`（收起再拉出）就能重新贴合。

## 卸载

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-oneclick-desktop
```

然后清掉桌面集成和残留：

```powershell
powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File ~\.dsh\plugins\dsh-oneclick-desktop\plugin\lib\desktop.ps1 -Mode remove
```

`~/.dsh/edge-deepseek-profile/`（chat 用的独立浏览器 profile）和
`~/.dsh/dsh-oneclick-desktop.{state,log}` 可以手动删掉。

## 实现说明

想改代码或了解踩过的坑，看 [DEVELOPING.md](DEVELOPING.md) —— 里面记了每个设计决定和它对应的实测证据，
包括：窗口边框四边不等宽、Edge app 窗口没有 per-window AUMID、`Start-Sleep` 的 15.6ms 粒度、
为什么不能用 `spawn(..., {detached:true})`、以及 `$env:ProgramFiles(x86)` 必须写成
`${env:ProgramFiles(x86)}`。

## License

MIT

plugins.description: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的 Claude Code 风格终端界面，支持 Windows、macOS 与 Linux，兼容透明终端、VS Code 主题和自定义配色。
plugins.readme_text:
> **Release compatibility:** The current tested Host is official `0.2.0-rc.2`. SeekTTY `1.3.0` is paired with that Host. See the [release notes](docs/release-v1.3.0.md) for changes and installation, and the [verification record](docs/release-v1.3.0-verification.md) for exact package evidence.

SeekTTY

A terminal workspace for DeepSeek Harness.

Overview · Quick start · Clarify and Plan · Features · Compatibility

English · 中文

--- ## Overview Run `deepseek` from a project directory to use the native Agent, Session, model, permission, Settings, Profile, plugin, and persistence services of [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) in one terminal workspace. SeekTTY is the terminal surface; Harness remains the owner of runtime state. Models, Providers, Agent Presets, permissions, commands, tools, Settings, Skills, MCP servers, and marketplace sources are discovered from the running Harness. Capabilities added by upstream or third-party Bundles therefore appear without being hard-coded into SeekTTY. For requirements that still need definition, the optional [Clarify Host plugin](https://github.com/Hilbert-beinghappy/dsh-plugin-clarify) adds a guided `/clarify` workflow. It asks focused questions, updates a reviewable Draft after each answer, and returns the accepted Draft to the composer. Harness-native `/plan` can then turn the submitted requirement into an implementation plan. ## Development checkout Build and install a local SeekTTY package from the repository root: ```sh pnpm add --global --config.enable-global-virtual-store=false @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.2.0-rc.2 pnpm install --frozen-lockfile pnpm run build pnpm pack dsh plugin --profile tui add --config.enable-global-virtual-store=false ./seektty-1.3.0.tgz dsh --profile tui ``` Use the local tarball for source development and testing. For the released package, use the exact npm version below. ## Quick start Install the published SeekTTY release on its verified official DeepSeek Harness `0.2.0-rc.2`: ```sh pnpm add --global --config.enable-global-virtual-store=false @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.2.0-rc.2 dsh plugin --profile tui add --config.enable-global-virtual-store=false seektty@1.3.0 dsh --profile tui ``` These commands install the prebuilt Bundle through native `dsh plugin` reconciliation. The per-command pnpm option avoids the pnpm 11 Global Virtual Store layout that the Cordis loader in the currently tested dsh releases cannot reliably load. SeekTTY never changes global pnpm configuration. Clarify and Auxiliary Runtime are optional, not default dependencies; their historical joint acceptance is listed under [Compatibility](#compatibility-and-verification). The exact `seektty@1.3.0` npm package is documented in the [release notes](docs/release-v1.3.0.md), [PR audit](docs/release-v1.3.0-pr-audit.md), and [verification record](docs/release-v1.3.0-verification.md). ### Bare `deepseek` launcher After installing `dsh`, install the same SeekTTY release globally and pin Profile reconciliation to its exact npm version: ```sh pnpm add --global --config.enable-global-virtual-store=false seektty@1.3.0 export SEEKTTY_SPEC=seektty@1.3.0 deepseek ``` PowerShell uses the same exact npm spec: ```powershell pnpm add --global --config.enable-global-virtual-store=false 'seektty@1.3.0' $env:SEEKTTY_SPEC='seektty@1.3.0' deepseek ``` `deepseek` requires `dsh` on `PATH`, or `DSH_BIN` pointing to its executable. Common launch forms include: ```sh deepseek "check this project" deepseek --cwd ../project deepseek --resume deepseek --resume deepseek --profile team-tui deepseek --version deepseek --update ``` `deepseek --update` is self-first: it checks SeekTTY before dsh, installs at most one compatible component per run, and never installs an untested gap or future Host. `DSH_BIN`, local installs, and `SEEKTTY_SPEC` overrides are left unchanged. Update failures do not block startup. Set `SEEKTTY_UPDATE=check` for a post-session notice or `SEEKTTY_UPDATE=0` to disable checks. SeekTTY `1.3.0` supports official dsh `0.2.0-rc.2` and brings more native workflows into the terminal. See the bilingual [release notes](docs/release-v1.3.0.md), [complete PR audit](docs/release-v1.3.0-pr-audit.md), and [verification record](docs/release-v1.3.0-verification.md). ### What's new in 1.3.0 - Access native Session actions, plans and artifacts, MCP resources, Team information, schedules, timed/continued questions, and account/model information from the terminal. - Browse Host workspace files with text/binary views and available file watching. Plugins can add terminal Session actions and guarded draft input activities with undo. - Install optional Creator, Browser, or Computer companion Bundles when you need them. With the official voice-input Bundle enabled, `/speech wav` provides reviewed WAV transcription; it does not record from the microphone. - Fix current-Host preset/forms/tool-result handling, stale targets, approval display, watcher cleanup, and bounded shutdown. Keep native Harness ownership and the existing terminal workflows. The release notes also fill gaps in the `1.2.6` summary: Agent Tree navigation, semantic transcript copying, target-specific context menus, Provider configuration, VS Code theme discovery, independent appearance controls, native scrollback, and long-session rendering fixes. Those features were already shipped; the [audit](docs/release-v1.3.0-pr-audit.md) identifies their original PRs and versions. ## Interface | DeepSeek light | DeepSeek dark | | --- | --- | | ![SeekTTY DeepSeek light start screen](assets/seektty-tui.png) | ![SeekTTY DeepSeek dark start screen](assets/seektty-tui-dark.png) | | TypeScript in the light interface | Tools, file reads, and Diff in the dark interface | | --- | --- | | ![SeekTTY light TypeScript syntax highlighting](assets/seektty-code-light.png) | ![SeekTTY dark tool and Diff syntax highlighting](assets/seektty-code-dark.png) | Full mode uses a fixed alternate-screen viewport and keeps the composer and status at the bottom. Its mouse support browses history, selects text, and clicks existing controls inside SeekTTY. F3 or `/mouse native` switches while idle to terminal-native mode: SeekTTY leaves the alternate screen, writes the complete loaded conversation to ordinary terminal scrollback, disables mouse reporting, and lets the terminal or tmux own scrolling, search, and selection. Backfill is sequential and reports progress; Esc stops it without stopping the Session, while Ctrl+L refreshes only the active tail. `/transcript` opens transcript browsing and `/transcript replay` explicitly writes the available conversation again. Images use a textual attachment row in native mode. Already-written history is not recolored or reflowed by SeekTTY; the terminal owns that history. An empty session now opens with a responsive Fastfetch-style welcome page rather than sendable task suggestions. The default uses a packaged, original-color DeepSeek pixel whale plus runtime facts from the current Profile; it does **not** execute Fastfetch. The first-time API-key prompt remains higher priority and finishes before option

plugins.description: Normify · DSH 插件：把项目架构写成归一化的分形模块树，三层校验（写时 / 校验 / 冻结回执）、30 个 normify_* 工具 + normify-gen 技能，一键渲染单文件交互式架构图；支持伴随式开发（change_open → brief → check → 实施 → refresh → change_close）。
plugins.readme_text:
English · 简体中文

Normify · 归一化框架图构建器

把整个项目描述成一棵"人机共读"的分形模块树：AI 负责分析与创作，确定性引擎负责校验、编译与渲染 —— 点开任意模块，就是一张更精细的子图。

--- ## 0. 一句话 Normify 是 **DeepSeek Harness（DSH）插件**，也是**一套写给 AI 用的开发流程**： - **给 AI 的**：`normify-gen` 技能 + **31 个 `normify_*` 工具** —— 让模型把仓库分析成模块树结构数据， 并在后续开发中**先建图后编程、伴随编程改图**（计划态建树 → 逐个实现 → 关单收尾）。 - **给引擎的**：零容忍校验（L1 写时 / L2 全项目 / L3 冻结）+ 确定性编译（`tree.json` 等四件产物，SHA-256 冻结） + 渲染数据（`renders/`，决定"每一层怎么画"）。 - **给人的**：**单文件交互式架构图**（`normify.html`）—— 逐层下钻、悬停看介绍、一键中英切换、深链接、 多树、**API 直连箭头**、跨层聚合、缩放与搜索。零依赖，双击即开。 > 它不是"生成一张图就结束"的工具：结构数据与代码**互为契约**，每次改动都能被 `normify_sync` 检出漂移， > 并以 `normify_change_close`（**0 error 强制**）收尾，让"代码 → 架构图"永远同步。


引擎层：14 个模块、API 直连箭头（箭头锚定到具体 API 行）、带标签的子系统依赖、跨层聚合虚线

## 1. 它解决什么问题 | 痛点 | Normify 的做法 | | --- | --- | | 架构图一画完就过期 | 结构数据是**可校验的源数据**：`normify_sync` 按 `fingerprint` 检出漂移，`normify_change_close` 强制 0 error 收尾 | | 图太粗，看不出接口契约 | 粒度到**单一功能单元**，API 写在叶子上，箭头可锚定到具体 API（`from_api`/`to_api`） | | AI 改代码时"看不见全局" | `normify_brief` 给出目标模块契约、影响面（谁依赖我）、规则约束与验收清单 | | 设计先写代码后补文档，必然漂移 | **计划态先建树**（`state: planned`）→ 实现后 `normify_module_refresh(activate)` 自动转 active | | 结构规范靠人自觉 | `policy.yml` 架构规则（依赖方向 / 禁依赖 / 无环 / 深度 / 跨树 / 命名）由 `validate` 强制执行 | | 大仓库一次生成太重 | 增量再生成：只重建受影响子树，`layouts_to_review` 点名要复核的层 | ## 2. 核心特性 ### 2.1 数据模型：分形 + 零冗余 - **唯一元素**：整个数据库由无数个结构完全相同的**基本模块**构成（每个模块 = 一个 Markdown 文件）。 - **只存 `parent`**：单方向引用，`children` 由索引导出 —— 不会出现"父子各说各话"。 - **API 只在叶子存一次**：聚合、统计、索引全部是编译期派生数据（`tree.json` / `api-index.json`）。 - **两类边**：containment（树边，导航骨架）+ dependency（箭头，可跨子树、跨树，按 `kind` 着色）。 - **路径式 id + 不变 uid**：AI 沿 id 逐层定位（类二分查找）；`uid` 在改名/移动时保持不变，git diff 稳定。 - **深度不设上限**（0.5.0 起）：想有多细就拆多细，深度不再成为"合并模块"的理由。 ### 2.2 三层校验，fail-closed | 层 | 时机 | 内容 | | --- | --- | --- | | **L1** | 每次写入 | 必填字段、id 文法、uid、parent 一致性、双语长度、source/apis/deps 形状、state/replacement | | **L2** | `normify_validate` | 全项目：唯一性、文件↔id 映射、叶子/非叶子规则、API 键唯一、依赖目标、环、渲染数据交叉校验、架构规则、变更日志、（可选）仓库证据（source 存在性 + 指纹一致） | | **L3** | `normify_build` | 任何 error 都不产出产物；产出即 SHA-256 冻结进 `receipt.json` | 每条诊断都带 `severity / code / message / subject / evidence / supportedFixes` —— **AI 可自行修复**。 ### 2.3 渲染器：单文件、可下钻、API 直连 - 单文件 HTML（内联 CSS/JS，**零外部依赖**、零遥测），双击即开，可直接归档/发人。 - 逐层下钻 + 面包屑 + 搜索（模块名/API）+ 大纲视图 + API 浏览器。 - **API 直连**：叶子框内展示 API 明细行，箭头锚定到具体 API 行的端口；同一 API 行上的多条边自动扇形分离。 - 跨层依赖聚合为虚线 `×N`（默认隐藏，工具栏或 `?agg=1` 开启，悬停看明细）。 - 深链接：`#module=`、`#api=`、`#view=outline`、`?lang=zh|en`、`?agg=1`；缩放 / 悬停高亮 / 明暗主题。 - **几何自检**：仓库自带 `check-geometry.mjs`，逐层断言"线不出界 / 不贴框 / 不穿框 / 不压线"。 ### 2.4 伴随开发：先建图后编程 ``` change_open → brief → check → module_batch(state=planned) → 【写代码】 → module_refresh(activate) → change_close(0 error 强制) → verified + revision.after ``` - **计划态**：源码还不存在也能先建树（`fingerprint: pending`），`validate` 放行； - **禁止假激活**：源码没落地就 `activate` 直接被拒； - **收尾即闭环**：`change_close` 会刷新指纹 → 校验（0 error 强制）→ 编译（可选渲染）→ 标记 `verified`， 任何一步失败都不关闭，变更保持原状态； - **改图随代码**：`normify_sync` 用 `git diff` + 未跟踪文件定位受影响模块与指纹漂移，`module_patch` 跟随更新。 ### 2.5 架构规则先行（policy.yml） | 规则 | 作用 | | --- | --- | | `dependency-direction` | 层顺序即允许的依赖方向（如 plugin → tools → engine），可控制同层是否允许 | | `forbid-dependency` | 禁止某些 from → to 的依赖（可按 kind / state 过滤） | | `acyclic` | 依赖图禁止成环（可含跨树） | | `max-depth` | id 段数上限（**可选**：不写就是不限，0.5.0 起默认不限） | | `cross-tree` | 跨树依赖策略：`forbid` / `allow` / `require-to-api` | | `naming` | 作用域内 id 段的命名正则 | 安装后 `normify_validate` / `normify_build` / `normify_check` 全部强制执行；**违规先改设计，不能绕过**。 ## 3. 最新变化 ### v0.5.4 · 把"第二轮 A/B 实测"暴露的 4 个工具缺陷修掉（当前版本） 第二轮 A/B 换了题目（**表格公式引擎 + CLI**，同一份规范、隐藏黑盒 88 项、外加**差分模糊测试**）。 两组最终 B 88/88、A 87/88（差异只有一条 §5.2 语义）；这一版修的是**工具侧**新暴露的 4 个坑： - **`mode:"patch"` 的静默 no-op 被拦下**：原来 `items:[{patch:{id, tags:[...]}}]`（少一层包装）会返回 `ok:true, count:1` 却**一个字段都没改**——最危险的"假成功"。现在直接报 `args/invalid-patch`， evidence 里给出收到的键与正确形状 `{patch:{id, patch:{...}}}`；单模块 `normify_module_patch` 传空补丁 同样报 `args/empty-patch`（只给 `expect_updated_at` 也不再静默通过）。 - **`normify_module_refresh` 不再强依赖 git**：`repoRoot` 不是 git 仓库时，以前直接 `refresh/git-failed` 失败（实测中 AI 只能 `git init` 才能激活模块）。现在改成**降级**：指纹照常重算、 `state` 照常激活，`revision` 保持模块原值，并给出 `refresh/git-unavailable` 警告与修法。 - **`change_open` 的 `acceptance` 报错具体化**：以前把 `{zh,en}` 写进 acceptance 只有一句笼统报错； 现在明确写出"**第 N 条不是非空字符串（收到 …）：验收标准只接受纯字符串**"，并提示双语描述写进 `title`/`intent`。 - **`normify_help` 支持 `topic:"tool:<工具名>"`**：`tools` 主题现在每个工具都带**必填/可选**摘要， 新主题可按需打印**完整参数树**（类型 / 描述 / 必填，由注册表实时生成、与运行时校验同源）。 实测里 AI 为确认 `mode=patch` 的嵌套形状去读了插件源码——这条主题正是为了消灭这种绕路。 ### v0.5.3 · 把「伴随编程实测」暴露的 4 个摩擦点修掉 这四个问题来自一次真实的 A/B 对照实验：两个 AI 用同一份规范写同一个后端，一个带插件走伴随流程、一个纯手写 （最终代码在隐藏黑盒验收上都是 **42/42**）。插件组多交付了 41 模块 / 110 API / 10 层的结构数据，但也踩到了下面 4 个坑： - **`normify_help` 支持 `topic`**：此前它完全忽略入参，只返回同一份字段速查 —— 实测里 AI 为了拿准 `change_open` / `layout_upsert` / `change_close` 的参数名，只能去读插件源码（多花约 4 分钟）。 现在按主题返回：`fields`（默认）/ `deps`（箭头与 API 直连）/ `renders` / `flow`（伴随流程）/ `tools`（工具清单）/ `policy` / `errors`（常见诊断码与修法）/ `all`；**传错主题会直接报错并列出可用主题**，不再静默忽略。 - **项目初始化通道**：新增第 31 个工具 `normify_project_init` —— 建 `normify-/` + 默认架构规则， 可选 `root` 一步创建"计划态根模块"（幂等）；同时 `normify_change_open` 现在也会**自动建项目目录** （此前报 `project/no-modules`，AI 只能用 `module_batch {items:[],dry_run:true}` 绕过去）； `normify_brief` 遇到不存在的模块会给出"先 init / 先建树 / 改用 task"的可执行提示。 - **批量诊断的因果链**：一条 `label-too-long` 曾连带出 3 条 `dep/target-missing`（因为 L1 失败的模块会被移出批次工作集）， AI 只能去读源码才能确认根因。现在连带错误改报 `dep/target-dropped` / `structure/parent-dropped`， 在 message 与 evidence 里点明**根因诊断码**，并在失败响应的 `root_causes` 里直接列出被丢弃的模块（附 `hint`）。 - **「API 直连」引导**：两端都声明了 API 却没写 `from_api` / `to_api` 的箭头，`normify_validate` 会给出**聚合** warning `dep/unanchored`（条数 + 前 3 条示例）。这正是实验里被浪费的能力：110 条 API 声明，54 条箭头 0 条锚定 —— 不锚定，箭头就只能落在框边，钉不到 API 行上。**引导≠放宽**：锚错键仍然是 error。 ### v0.5.2 · 修掉三处会写坏数据的真实缺陷 - **`normify_module_upsert` 的必填表不再丢失**：`parameters.required` 恢复为 `["frontmatter"]`， `frontmatter` 的 9 个必填字段（uid / id / parent / name / description / source / revision / updated_at / fingerprint） 也重新出现在 schema 里。此前嵌套 schema 被二次编译，必填表被整段丢掉 —— 模型看到的约束与运行时实际校验不一致。 - **`normify_module_move` 迁移渲染数据时重写内容**：`id` / `order` / `groups.children` / `edge_hints` 全部改写到新 id， 并同步维护**旧父级**（删掉已迁出子模块的引用）与**新父级**（把新 id 补进 `order`）。 修复前：move 完之后项目立刻被 L2 判为 `layout/id-mismatch` + `layout/order-child` 等（实测 8–9 个 error，0.5.2 后为 0）。 - **晋升为容器时不再把 API 留在容器上**：叶子被晋升（显式 `normify_module_promote`、写子模块自动晋升、move 到叶子底下） 时，容器上残留的 `apis` 会被摘除，并回报 `structure/api-dropped-on-promote` 警告（附丢失的 API 键清单）—— 修复前项目会直接卡在 `api/non-leaf`。 - **API 默认全展开**：渲染数据字段 `max_api_rows` 缺省 **0 = 全部展开**，叶子上的 API 一行不折叠；需要收窄时显式写 1..48。 - 三处缺陷各自配了回归断言：`tests/regression-0.5.2.mjs`（34 项，全绿）。 ### v0.5.1 · 渲染器防重叠（线压线 12 → 0） - **修复连线共线重叠**：28 层合计 **12 处 → 0 处**。四处根因： ① 首选路由只判"不穿别人的框"，从不检查是否压到已画的线 → 改为只接受 `violations === 0` 的候选； ② API 锚定端口没有端口分离（同一 API 行被多条边共用） → 行内 ±5.5px 扇形分离； ③ API 端口落在上下边时被放进框内部 → 上下边退回按边均匀分离； ④ `segClear` 整块跳过源/目标框 → 新增"进入自身框内部"检查（内缩 2px）。 - 节点/分组间距 170 → 220，给密集层更多自由通道。 ### v0.5.0 · 取消模块数量上限 - **删除 `MAX_DEPTH = 12`** 硬限制：树可以一直下钻到"单一功能单元"；需要限层时用 `policy.yml` 的 `max-depth` 规则显式声明（`maxDepth` 放宽到 1..64）。 - SKILL：目标深度改为"不设上限"，单批上限 40 → 200，新增"每叶 API 尽量 3–5 条"的粒度指引。
更早的版本（v0.4.x / v0.3 / v0.2 / v0.1） - **v0.4.1**：渲染器 v3 定稿（自由通道走线、viewBox 全几何自适应、API 直连、跨层聚合、缩放与悬停）； `normify_sync` 识别**未跟踪的新文件**（`git ls-files --others`）。 - **v0.4.0**：伴随开发（`state: pla

> **Release compatibility:** The current tested Host is official `0.2.0-rc.2`. SeekTTY `1.3.0` is paired with that Host. See the [release notes](docs/release-v1.3.0.md) for changes and installation, and the [verification record](docs/release-v1.3.0-verification.md) for exact package evidence.

SeekTTY

A terminal workspace for DeepSeek Harness.

Overview · Quick start · Clarify and Plan · Features · Compatibility

English · 中文

--- ## Overview Run `deepseek` from a project directory to use the native Agent, Session, model, permission, Settings, Profile, plugin, and persistence services of [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) in one terminal workspace. SeekTTY is the terminal surface; Harness remains the owner of runtime state. Models, Providers, Agent Presets, permissions, commands, tools, Settings, Skills, MCP servers, and marketplace sources are discovered from the running Harness. Capabilities added by upstream or third-party Bundles therefore appear without being hard-coded into SeekTTY. For requirements that still need definition, the optional [Clarify Host plugin](https://github.com/Hilbert-beinghappy/dsh-plugin-clarify) adds a guided `/clarify` workflow. It asks focused questions, updates a reviewable Draft after each answer, and returns the accepted Draft to the composer. Harness-native `/plan` can then turn the submitted requirement into an implementation plan. ## Development checkout Build and install a local SeekTTY package from the repository root: ```sh pnpm add --global --config.enable-global-virtual-store=false @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.2.0-rc.2 pnpm install --frozen-lockfile pnpm run build pnpm pack dsh plugin --profile tui add --config.enable-global-virtual-store=false ./seektty-1.3.0.tgz dsh --profile tui ``` Use the local tarball for source development and testing. For the released package, use the exact npm version below. ## Quick start Install the published SeekTTY release on its verified official DeepSeek Harness `0.2.0-rc.2`: ```sh pnpm add --global --config.enable-global-virtual-store=false @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.2.0-rc.2 dsh plugin --profile tui add --config.enable-global-virtual-store=false seektty@1.3.0 dsh --profile tui ``` These commands install the prebuilt Bundle through native `dsh plugin` reconciliation. The per-command pnpm option avoids the pnpm 11 Global Virtual Store layout that the Cordis loader in the currently tested dsh releases cannot reliably load. SeekTTY never changes global pnpm configuration. Clarify and Auxiliary Runtime are optional, not default dependencies; their historical joint acceptance is listed under [Compatibility](#compatibility-and-verification). The exact `seektty@1.3.0` npm package is documented in the [release notes](docs/release-v1.3.0.md), [PR audit](docs/release-v1.3.0-pr-audit.md), and [verification record](docs/release-v1.3.0-verification.md). ### Bare `deepseek` launcher After installing `dsh`, install the same SeekTTY release globally and pin Profile reconciliation to its exact npm version: ```sh pnpm add --global --config.enable-global-virtual-store=false seektty@1.3.0 export SEEKTTY_SPEC=seektty@1.3.0 deepseek ``` PowerShell uses the same exact npm spec: ```powershell pnpm add --global --config.enable-global-virtual-store=false 'seektty@1.3.0' $env:SEEKTTY_SPEC='seektty@1.3.0' deepseek ``` `deepseek` requires `dsh` on `PATH`, or `DSH_BIN` pointing to its executable. Common launch forms include: ```sh deepseek "check this project" deepseek --cwd ../project deepseek --resume deepseek --resume deepseek --profile team-tui deepseek --version deepseek --update ``` `deepseek --update` is self-first: it checks SeekTTY before dsh, installs at most one compatible component per run, and never installs an untested gap or future Host. `DSH_BIN`, local installs, and `SEEKTTY_SPEC` overrides are left unchanged. Update failures do not block startup. Set `SEEKTTY_UPDATE=check` for a post-session notice or `SEEKTTY_UPDATE=0` to disable checks. SeekTTY `1.3.0` supports official dsh `0.2.0-rc.2` and brings more native workflows into the terminal. See the bilingual [release notes](docs/release-v1.3.0.md), [complete PR audit](docs/release-v1.3.0-pr-audit.md), and [verification record](docs/release-v1.3.0-verification.md). ### What's new in 1.3.0 - Access native Session actions, plans and artifacts, MCP resources, Team information, schedules, timed/continued questions, and account/model information from the terminal. - Browse Host workspace files with text/binary views and available file watching. Plugins can add terminal Session actions and guarded draft input activities with undo. - Install optional Creator, Browser, or Computer companion Bundles when you need them. With the official voice-input Bundle enabled, `/speech wav` provides reviewed WAV transcription; it does not record from the microphone. - Fix current-Host preset/forms/tool-result handling, stale targets, approval display, watcher cleanup, and bounded shutdown. Keep native Harness ownership and the existing terminal workflows. The release notes also fill gaps in the `1.2.6` summary: Agent Tree navigation, semantic transcript copying, target-specific context menus, Provider configuration, VS Code theme discovery, independent appearance controls, native scrollback, and long-session rendering fixes. Those features were already shipped; the [audit](docs/release-v1.3.0-pr-audit.md) identifies their original PRs and versions. ## Interface | DeepSeek light | DeepSeek dark | | --- | --- | | ![SeekTTY DeepSeek light start screen](assets/seektty-tui.png) | ![SeekTTY DeepSeek dark start screen](assets/seektty-tui-dark.png) | | TypeScript in the light interface | Tools, file reads, and Diff in the dark interface | | --- | --- | | ![SeekTTY light TypeScript syntax highlighting](assets/seektty-code-light.png) | ![SeekTTY dark tool and Diff syntax highlighting](assets/seektty-code-dark.png) | Full mode uses a fixed alternate-screen viewport and keeps the composer and status at the bottom. Its mouse support browses history, selects text, and clicks existing controls inside SeekTTY. F3 or `/mouse native` switches while idle to terminal-native mode: SeekTTY leaves the alternate screen, writes the complete loaded conversation to ordinary terminal scrollback, disables mouse reporting, and lets the terminal or tmux own scrolling, search, and selection. Backfill is sequential and reports progress; Esc stops it without stopping the Session, while Ctrl+L refreshes only the active tail. `/transcript` opens transcript browsing and `/transcript replay` explicitly writes the available conversation again. Images use a textual attachment row in native mode. Already-written history is not recolored or reflowed by SeekTTY; the terminal owns that history. An empty session now opens with a responsive Fastfetch-style welcome page rather than sendable task suggestions. The default uses a packaged, original-color DeepSeek pixel whale plus runtime facts from the current Profile; it does **not** execute Fastfetch. The first-time API-key prompt remains higher priority and finishes before option
